title.zh: 卷十七 本紀第十七: 哀宗上
title.raw: 卷十七 本紀第十七: 哀宗上 Volume 17 Annals 17: Aizong 1

sentences.zh: 哀宗諱守緒，初諱守禮，又諱寧甲速，宣宗第三子。

translations.literal: Emperor Aizong’s taboo name was Shouxu; he was first named Shouli, and earlier Ningjiasu—the third son of Emperor Xuanzong.
translations.idiomatic: Emperor Aizong’s taboo name was Shouxu. He had first been Shouli, and before that Ningjiasu—Xuanzong’s third son.

sentences.zh: 母曰明惠皇后王氏，賜姓溫敦氏，仁聖皇后之女兄也。

translations.literal: His mother was Empress Minghui of the Wang clan, granted the surname Wendun, elder sister to Empress Rensheng.
translations.idiomatic: His mother was Empress Minghui, née Wang, of the granted Wendun clan—elder sister to Empress Rensheng.

sentences.zh: 承安三年八月二十三日生於翼邸，仁聖無子，養為己子。

translations.literal: On the twenty-third day of the eighth month of the third year of Cheng’an he was born at the Yi residence; Rensheng had no son and raised him as her own.
translations.idiomatic: He was born at the Yi residence on the twenty-third of the eighth month, Cheng’an year 3. Rensheng had no son and reared him as her own.

sentences.zh: 泰和中，授金紫光祿大夫。

translations.literal: In the Taihe era he was appointed Grand Mentor of the Golden Purple Glow.
translations.idiomatic: During Taihe he received the rank Grand Mentor of the Golden Purple Glow.

sentences.zh: 宣宗登極，進封遂王，授秘書監，改樞密使。

translations.literal: When Xuanzong took the throne, he was advanced to Prince of Sui, made Director of the Secretariat, and then Privy Councilor.
translations.idiomatic: When Xuanzong ascended, he was made Prince of Sui, director of the Secretariat, and then privy councilor.

sentences.zh: 貞祐初，莊獻太子守忠薨，立皇孫鏗為皇太孫，尋又薨。

translations.literal: Early in Zhenyou, Crown Prince Zhuangxian Shouzhong died; the imperial grandson Keng was made imperial great-grandson, but soon died as well.
translations.idiomatic: Early in Zhenyou Crown Prince Zhuangxian Shouzhong died. The court made his grandson Keng imperial great-grandson; he too died soon after.

sentences.zh: 四年正月己卯，立守禮為皇太子，仍控制樞密院事，詔略曰：「子以母貴，遂王守禮地鄰塚嫡，慶集元妃，立為皇太子，其典禮有司條具以聞。

translations.literal: In the fourth year, first month, on jimao, Shouli was installed as crown prince, still controlling Privy Council affairs. The edict in summary said: "A son rises when his mother is honored. Prince of Sui Shouli’s standing neighbors that of the heir of the main line; joy has gathered on the Principal Consort—install him as crown prince. Let the relevant offices set out the full ritual and report.
translations.idiomatic: Fourth year, first month, jimao: Shouli was made crown prince and kept charge of the Privy Council. The edict in brief ran: "The son follows the mother’s honor. Prince of Sui Shouli stands beside the legitimate heir of the main line; fortune has settled on the Principal Consort—make him crown prince. Let the ritual offices draft the full ceremony and report.

sentences.zh: 」四月甲午，用太子少保張行信言，更賜名守緒。

translations.literal: " In the fourth month, on jiawu, following Grand Guardian of the Heir Zhang Xingxin’s advice, he was granted the new name Shouxu.
translations.idiomatic: " Fourth month, jiawu: on Grand Guardian of the Heir Zhang Xingxin’s advice he was given the new taboo name Shouxu.

sentences.zh: 元光二年十二月庚寅，宣宗崩。

translations.literal: In the twelfth month of the second year of Yuanguang, on gengyin, Xuanzong died.
translations.idiomatic: Yuanguang year 2, twelfth month, gengyin: Xuanzong died.

sentences.zh: 辛卯，奉遺詔即皇帝位於柩前。

translations.literal: On xinmao he received the testamentary edict and took the throne before the coffin.
translations.idiomatic: On xinmao he took the testamentary edict and ascended before the bier.

sentences.zh: 壬辰，詔大赦，略曰：「朕述先帝之遺意，有便於時欲行而未及者，悉奉而行之。

translations.literal: On renchen a great amnesty was proclaimed, in summary: "We carry out the late emperor’s intent—whatever timely measures he wished but had not yet enacted, enact them all."
translations.idiomatic: On renchen he proclaimed a great amnesty, in brief: "I follow the late emperor’s intent: whatever timely measures he meant to take but had not, take them all now."

sentences.zh: 國家已有定制，有司往往以情破法，使人罔遭刑憲，今後有本條而不遵者，以故入人罪罪之。

translations.literal: The state already has fixed statutes, yet offices often bend law to private feeling so that people never meet punishment—hereafter whoever has a statute on point and does not follow it shall be punished for wrongful prosecution.
translations.idiomatic: The realm already has fixed law, yet offices often break it for private feeling so men never face punishment. Hereafter, whoever has a statute on point and ignores it shall be convicted of wrongful prosecution.

sentences.zh: 草澤士庶，許令直言軍國利害，雖涉譏諷無可採取者，並不坐罪。」

translations.literal: Commoners in field and town may speak plainly on military and state affairs; even if their words touch satire and are not worth adopting, they shall not be punished."
translations.idiomatic: Men in field and town may speak plainly on war and state; even if their words sting and are not worth heeding, they shall not be punished."

sentences.zh: 正大元年春正月戊戌朔，詔改元正大。

translations.literal: In spring of the first year of Zhengda, on the first day of the first month, wuxu new moon, an edict changed the era name to Zhengda.
translations.idiomatic: Zhengda year 1, spring, first month, wuxu new moon: an edict changed the era name to Zhengda.

sentences.zh: 庚子，上居廬，百官始奏事。

translations.literal: On gengzi the emperor dwelt in the mourning lodge; the hundred officials began to submit business.
translations.idiomatic: On gengzi the emperor kept mourning lodge; officials at last began to present business.

sentences.zh: 秘書監、權吏部侍郎蒲察合住改恆州刺史，左司員外郎泥旁古華山同知楨州軍州事，逐二奸臣，大夫士相賀。

translations.literal: Director of the Secretariat and acting Vice Minister of Personnel Pucha Hezhu was made prefect of Heng, Left Secretariat clerk Nibangu Huashan made deputy military commissioner of Zhen Prefecture—two corrupt ministers were driven out, and great and small rejoiced.
translations.idiomatic: Pucha Hezhu, director of the Secretariat and acting vice minister of personnel, was sent to Heng Prefecture; Nibangu Huashan, Left Secretariat clerk, became deputy military commissioner of Zhen—two corrupt ministers were expelled, and court and country rejoiced.

sentences.zh: 邠州節度使移剌朮納阿卜貢白兔，詔曰：「得賢臣輔佐，年谷豐登，此上瑞也，焉事此為。

translations.literal: Bin Prefecture military commissioner Yila Zhuna’abu presented a white hare. An edict said: "With worthy ministers in support and harvests full, that is the supreme omen—why bother with this?
translations.idiomatic: Yila Zhuna’abu, military commissioner of Bin, sent up a white hare. The edict read: "Worthy ministers at my side and grain in the bins—that is the supreme omen. Why trouble with this?

sentences.zh: 令有司給道裏費，從之本土。

translations.literal: Order the offices to supply travel expenses and send it back to its native place.
translations.idiomatic: Let the offices pay its travel costs and return it to its home ground.

sentences.zh: 禮部其遍諭四方，使知朕意。

translations.literal: Let the Ministry of Rites proclaim this everywhere so all know Our mind.
translations.idiomatic: Let the Ministry of Rites spread this everywhere so all know my mind.

sentences.zh: 」丁巳，詔朝臣議修復河中府。

translations.literal: " On dingsi an edict ordered court ministers to discuss restoring Hezhong Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: " On dingsi the throne ordered the court to debate restoring Hezhong Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 禮部尚書趙秉文、太常卿楊雲翼等言，陝西民方疲敝，未堪力役。

translations.literal: Minister of Rites Zhao Bingwen, Director of Court Music Yang Yunyi, and others said the people of Shaanxi were still exhausted and could not bear corvée.
translations.idiomatic: Zhao Bingwen, minister of rites, Yang Yunyi, director of court music, and others said Shaanxi folk were still spent and could not bear corvée.

sentences.zh: 遂止。

translations.literal: The plan was stopped.
translations.idiomatic: The plan died.

sentences.zh: 戊午，上始視朝。

translations.literal: On wuwu the emperor first held court.
translations.idiomatic: On wuwu the emperor at last held audience.

sentences.zh: 大司農、守汝州防禦使李蹊為太常卿，權參知政事。

translations.literal: Grand Minister of Agriculture and defender of Ruzhou Li Xi was made Director of Court Music and acting participation councillor.
translations.idiomatic: Li Xi, grand minister of agriculture and defender of Ruzhou, became director of court music and acting participation councillor.

sentences.zh: 平章政事荊王守純罷，判睦親府。

translations.literal: Chief Councillor Prince Jing Shouchun was dismissed and assigned to the Office of Imperial Kin.
translations.idiomatic: Chief councillor Prince Jing Shouchun was removed and put in charge of the Office of Imperial Kin.

sentences.zh: 參知政事僕散五斤罷，充大行山陵使。

translations.literal: Participation Councillor Pusan Wujin was dismissed and made chief envoy for the imperial burial procession.
translations.idiomatic: Participation councillor Pusan Wujin was removed and made chief envoy for the imperial burial.

sentences.zh: 尊皇后溫敦氏、元妃溫敦氏皆為皇太后，號其宮一曰仁聖，一曰慈聖。

translations.literal: Empress Wendun and Principal Consort Wendun were both honored as empress dowager; one palace was titled Rensheng, the other Cisheng.
translations.idiomatic: Empress Wendun and Principal Consort Wendun were both raised to empress dowager; one palace took the name Rensheng, the other Cisheng.

sentences.zh: 百官入賀於隆德殿。

translations.literal: The hundred officials entered to congratulate at Longde Hall.
translations.idiomatic: The hundred officials entered Longde Hall to offer congratulations.

sentences.zh: 是日，大風飄端門瓦。

translations.literal: That day a great wind blew tiles from the Duan Gate.
translations.idiomatic: That day a great wind stripped tiles from the Duan Gate.

sentences.zh: 赤盞合喜權樞密副使。

translations.literal: Chisan Hexi was made acting vice privy councilor.
translations.idiomatic: Chisan Hexi was named acting vice privy councilor.

sentences.zh: 有男子服麻衣，望承天門且笑且哭。

translations.literal: A man in hemp mourning dress looked toward Chengtian Gate, laughing and weeping by turns.
translations.idiomatic: A man in hemp mourning stood before Chengtian Gate, laughing and weeping by turns.

sentences.zh: 詰之，則曰：「吾笑，笑將相無人；

translations.literal: When questioned he said: "I laugh—laugh that among ministers and generals there is no one;
translations.idiomatic: Questioned, he said, "I laugh—laugh that among ministers and generals there is no one;

sentences.zh: 吾哭，哭金國將亡。

translations.literal: I weep—weep that the Jin state is about to perish."
translations.idiomatic: I weep—weep that Jin is about to fall."

sentences.zh: 」群臣請置重典，上持不可，曰：「近詔草澤諸人直言，雖涉譏訕不坐。

translations.literal: " The ministers asked for heavy punishment; the emperor would not allow it and said: "The recent edict lets commoners speak plainly—even if it touches satire, they are not punished.
translations.idiomatic: " The ministers asked for harsh punishment; the emperor refused: "My recent edict lets commoners speak plainly—even satire does not bring punishment.

sentences.zh: 」法司唯以君門非笑哭之所，重杖而遣之。

translations.literal: " The law officers held only that the sovereign’s gate is no place for laughter or tears; he was heavily caned and sent away.
translations.idiomatic: " The law officers held only that the sovereign’s gate is no place for laughter or tears; he was heavily caned and dismissed.

sentences.zh: 南陽民布陳謀反，伏誅。

translations.literal: Bu Chen of Nanyang plotted rebellion and was executed.
translations.idiomatic: Bu Chen of Nanyang plotted rebellion and was put to death.

sentences.zh: 三月，熒惑犯左執法。

translations.literal: In the third month Mars trespassed on the Left Law star.
translations.idiomatic: Third month: Mars crossed the Left Law star.

sentences.zh: 戊申，奉安宣宗禦容于孝嚴寺。

translations.literal: On wushen Xuanzong’s imperial portrait was installed at Xiaoyan Temple.
translations.idiomatic: On wushen Xuanzong’s portrait was installed at Xiaoyan Temple.

sentences.zh: 辛亥，丞相高汝礪薨。

translations.literal: On xinhai Chief Councillor Gao Rulü died.
translations.idiomatic: On xinhai chief councillor Gao Rulü died.

sentences.zh: 癸丑，葬宣宗於德陵。

translations.literal: On guichou Xuanzong was buried at De Mausoleum.
translations.idiomatic: On guichou Xuanzong was buried at De Mausoleum.

sentences.zh: 甲寅。

translations.literal: On jiayin.
translations.idiomatic: On jiayin.

sentences.zh: 起複邠州節度使致仕張行信為尚書左丞。

translations.literal: Retired Bin Prefecture military commissioner Zhang Xingxin was recalled from mourning and made Left Vice Director of the Masters of Writing.
translations.idiomatic: Zhang Xingxin, retired military commissioner of Bin, was recalled from mourning and made left vice director of the Masters of Writing.

sentences.zh: 以延安帥臣完顏合達戰禦有功，授金虎符，權參知政事，行尚書省事於京兆，兼統河東兩路。

translations.literal: Because Yan’an commander Wanyan Heda had merit in battle and defense, he was given the golden tiger tally, made acting participation councillor, and directed Masters of Writing affairs at Jingzhao while also commanding both Hedong circuits.
translations.idiomatic: Wanyan Heda, commander at Yan’an, had merit in battle and defense; he received the golden tiger tally, became acting participation councillor, ran Masters of Writing affairs at Jingzhao, and took both Hedong circuits.

sentences.zh: 夏四月癸酉，宣宗祔廟，大赦中外。

translations.literal: Summer, fourth month, guiyou: Xuanzong was enshrined in the Ancestral Temple and a great amnesty was proclaimed within and without.
translations.idiomatic: Summer, fourth month, guiyou: Xuanzong entered the Ancestral Temple and the court proclaimed a great amnesty at home and abroad.

sentences.zh: 熒惑犯右執法。

translations.literal: Mars trespassed on the Right Law star.
translations.idiomatic: Mars crossed the Right Law star.

sentences.zh: 六月甲戌，宰執請擊鞠，上以心喪不許，辛卯，立妃徒單氏為皇后。

translations.literal: Sixth month, jiaxu: the chief ministers asked to play cuju; the emperor, in heart-mourning, refused. On xinmao the consort of the Tushi clan was installed as empress.
translations.idiomatic: Sixth month, jiaxu: the chief ministers asked to kick the ball; the emperor, still in heart-mourning, refused. On xinmao Consort Tushi was made empress.

sentences.zh: 遣樞密判官移剌蒲阿率兵至光州，榜諭宋界軍民更不南伐。

translations.literal: Privy Council vice commissioner Yila Pu’a was sent with troops to Guang Prefecture to placard the Song border armies and people that they should not raid south again.
translations.idiomatic: Privy Council vice commissioner Yila Pu’a marched to Guang Prefecture and posted notices on the Song border telling troops and people to raid south no more.

sentences.zh: 秋七月己亥，詔諭百官各勤乃職。

translations.literal: Autumn, seventh month, on jihai an edict urged the hundred officials each to attend to his duty.
translations.idiomatic: Autumn, seventh month, jihai: an edict urged every official to mind his charge.

sentences.zh: 癸卯，補修大樂。

translations.literal: On guimao the great court music was repaired and restored.
translations.idiomatic: On guimao the great court music was repaired.

sentences.zh: 九月，樞密判官移剌蒲阿複澤、潞、獲馬千疋。

translations.literal: In the ninth month Privy Council vice commissioner Yila Pu’a recovered a thousand horses from Ze, Lu, and Huo.
translations.idiomatic: Ninth month: Privy Council vice commissioner Yila Pu’a recovered a thousand horses from Ze, Lu, and Huo.

sentences.zh: 冬十月戊午，夏國遣使來修好。

translations.literal: Winter, tenth month, wuwu: Xia sent envoys to renew friendly relations.
translations.idiomatic: In winter, on the tenth month’s wuwu, Xia dispatched envoys to renew friendly relations.

sentences.zh: 十二月乙巳，恆州刺史蒲察合住有罪，伏誅。

translations.literal: Twelfth month, yisi: Hengzhou Prefect Pucha Hezhu was guilty and executed.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month, on yisi, Hengzhou Prefect Pucha Hezhu was found guilty and put to death.

sentences.zh: 甲寅，宣宗小祥，燒飯於德陵。

translations.literal: On jiayin the emperor observed Xuandzong’s lesser mourning and burned food offerings at Deling.
translations.idiomatic: On jiayin the emperor kept Xuandzong’s lesser mourning and burned food offerings at Deling.

sentences.zh: 改定辟舉縣令法，以六事課縣令。

translations.literal: The law on recommending county magistrates was revised, with the six criteria used to evaluate magistrates.
translations.idiomatic: The law on recommending county magistrates was revised, and magistrates were graded on the six criteria.

sentences.zh: 京東、西、南，陝西設大司農司，兼採訪公事，京師大司農總之。

translations.literal: Grand Agriculture Offices were set up on the eastern, western, and southern capital routes and in Shaanxi, with concurrent inspection duties, all under the capital Grand Agriculture Office.
translations.idiomatic: Grand Agriculture Offices were established on the eastern, western, and southern capital routes and in Shaanxi, each with concurrent inspection duties, under the capital Grand Agriculture Office.

sentences.zh: 左丞張行信言：「先帝詔國內，刑不上大夫，治以廉恥。

translations.literal: Left Deputy Zhang Xingxin said: “The late emperor decreed that within the realm punishment does not reach grandees and that they be governed by a sense of shame.
translations.idiomatic: Left Deputy Zhang Xingxin said: “The late emperor decreed that within the realm punishment does not reach grandees and that they be ruled by shame.

sentences.zh: 丞相高琪所定職官犯罪的決百餘條，乞改依舊制。

translations.literal: Grand Councillor Gao Qi fixed more than a hundred articles on punishing officials who commit crimes; I ask that the old system be restored.”
translations.idiomatic: Grand Councillor Gao Qi drafted more than a hundred articles on punishing offending officials; I ask that the old system be restored.”

sentences.zh: 」上不欲彰先帝之過，略施行之。

translations.literal: The emperor did not wish to expose the late emperor’s fault and carried it out in part.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor did not wish to highlight the late emperor’s error and put the change into effect only in part.

sentences.zh: 二年春正月甲申，有黃黑之昆。

translations.literal: In the second year, spring, first month, jiashen: yellow-black clouds appeared.
translations.idiomatic: In the second year, on the first month’s jiashen, yellow-black clouds appeared.

sentences.zh: 夏四月辛卯朔，恆山公武仙自真定府來奔。

translations.literal: Summer, fourth month, xinmao new moon: Duke of Hengshan Wu Xian came to defect from Zhending Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: In summer, on the fourth month’s xinmao new moon, Duke of Hengshan Wu Xian defected from Zhending Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 起複平章政事致仕莘國公胥鼎為平章政事，行省事于衛州，進封英國公。

translations.literal: Retired Grand Councillor Xu Ding of the Duke of Xin State was recalled to grand councillor, with traveling secretariat affairs at Weizhou, and advanced to Duke of Ying.
translations.idiomatic: Retired Grand Councillor Xu Ding, Duke of Xin, was recalled as grand councillor with traveling secretariat duties at Weizhou and advanced to Duke of Ying.

sentences.zh: 甲午，以京畿旱，遣使慮囚。

translations.literal: On jiawu, because the capital region was drought-stricken, envoys were sent to review prisoners.
translations.idiomatic: On jiawu, with drought in the capital region, envoys were sent to review prisoners.

sentences.zh: 鈞、許州大雨雹。

translations.literal: Jun and Xu prefectures had heavy hail.
translations.idiomatic: Jun and Xu prefectures were struck by heavy hail.

sentences.zh: 丁酉，宿、鄭州雨傷麥。

translations.literal: On dingyou, rain in Su and Zheng prefectures damaged the wheat.
translations.idiomatic: On dingyou rain in Su and Zheng prefectures damaged the wheat crop.

sentences.zh: 五月丁丑，以旱甚責己，避正殿，減常膳，赦罪。

translations.literal: Fifth month, dingchou: because the drought was severe the emperor blamed himself, avoided the main hall, reduced his regular meals, and granted amnesty.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month, on dingchou, with drought severe the emperor blamed himself, stayed out of the main hall, cut his regular meals, and granted amnesty.

sentences.zh: 蘇椿自大名來奔，詔置椿許州。

translations.literal: Su Chun came to defect from Daming; an edict placed Chun at Xuzhou.
translations.idiomatic: Su Chun defected from Daming; an edict stationed Chun at Xuzhou.

sentences.zh: 秋七月，都水蒲察毛花輦殺人，免死除名。

translations.literal: Autumn, seventh month: Directorate of Waterways official Pucha Maohua killed someone; death was waived and he was struck from the rolls.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month Pucha Maohua of the Directorate of Waterways killed someone; he was spared execution but struck from the rolls.

sentences.zh: 八月，鞏州元帥田瑞反，行省軍圍之，其母弟十哥殺瑞出降，赦其罪，以為涇州節度使，世襲猛安。

translations.literal: Eighth month: Gongzhou Marshal Tian Rui rebelled; traveling secretariat troops besieged him, and his younger brother Shige killed Rui and surrendered; his crime was pardoned and he was made Jingzhou Military Commissioner with hereditary meng’an status.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month Gongzhou Marshal Tian Rui rebelled; traveling secretariat troops besieged him until his younger brother Shige killed Rui and surrendered; he was pardoned and made Jingzhou military commissioner with hereditary meng’an status.

sentences.zh: 九月，夏國和議定，以兄事金，各用本國年號，遣使來聘，奉國書稱弟。

translations.literal: Ninth month: peace with Xia was settled; they were to treat Jin as an elder brother, each side to use its own reign title; envoys came on embassy, and their state letter styled themselves the younger brother.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month peace with Xia was settled: Xia would treat Jin as elder brother while each kept its own reign title; envoys came on embassy with a state letter calling themselves the younger brother.

sentences.zh: 冬十月，以夏國修好，詔中外。

translations.literal: Winter, tenth month: because relations with Xia had been restored, an edict announced it within and without.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth month, with Xia relations restored, an edict announced it throughout the realm.

sentences.zh: 新軍政改總領為都尉。

translations.literal: The New Army Administration changed “chief controller” to “commandant.”
translations.idiomatic: The New Army Administration renamed chief controller to commandant.

sentences.zh: 己酉，以誅田瑞詔中外。

translations.literal: On jiyou an edict announced Tian Rui’s execution within and without.
translations.idiomatic: On jiyou an edict announced Tian Rui’s execution throughout the realm.

sentences.zh: 癸亥，遣禮部尚書奧敦良弼、大理卿裴滿欽甫、侍御史烏古孫弘毅為夏國報成使，國書稱兄。

translations.literal: On guihai Minister of Rites Aodun Liangbi, Court of Judicial Review Director Puman Qinfu, and Attending Censor Wugulun Hongyi were sent as envoys to report the completed Xia treaty; the state letter used “elder brother.”
translations.idiomatic: On guihai Minister of Rites Aodun Liangbi, Court of Judicial Review Director Puman Qinfu, and Attending Censor Wugulun Hongyi were dispatched as envoys to report the completed Xia treaty; the state letter addressed Jin as elder brother.

sentences.zh: 乙亥，面諭台諫完顏素蘭、陳規曰：「宋人輕犯邊界，我以輕騎襲之，冀其懲創通好，以息吾民耳。

translations.literal: On yihai the emperor addressed the remonstrance officials Wanyan Sulan and Chen Gui face to face: “Song lightly violate the border; I raid them with light cavalry hoping they will be chastened and open peace talks to give my people rest.
translations.idiomatic: On yihai the emperor told remonstrance officials Wanyan Sulan and Chen Gui in person: “Song lightly violate the border; I raid them with light horse hoping they will be chastened into peace and give my people rest.

sentences.zh: 夏人從來臣屬我朝，今稱弟以和，我尚不以為辱。

translations.literal: Xia have always been subjects of our court; now they call themselves younger brother to make peace, and I do not even find that shameful.
translations.idiomatic: Xia have long been subjects of our court; now they style themselves younger brother to make peace, and I do not even count that shameful.

sentences.zh: 果得和好，以安吾民，尚欲用兵乎。

translations.literal: If we truly secure peace and settle the people, do we still wish to use arms?
translations.idiomatic: If we truly secure peace and settle the people, do we still want war?

sentences.zh: 卿等宜悉朕意。

translations.literal: You should all grasp my intent.”
translations.idiomatic: You should all grasp my intent.”

sentences.zh: 」移剌蒲阿及宋人戰於光州，獲馬數千，數人千餘而還。

translations.literal: Yila Pu’a fought Song at Guangzhou, took several thousand horses, and returned with more than a thousand captives.
translations.idiomatic: Yila Pu’a fought Song at Guangzhou, seized several thousand horses, and returned with more than a thousand captives.

sentences.zh: 內族王家奴故殺鮮于主簿，權貴多救之者，上曰：「英王朕兄，敢妄撻一人乎？

translations.literal: Imperial clansman Wang Jianu had deliberately killed Registrar Xianyu; many of the powerful sought to save him. The emperor said: “Prince Ying is my elder brother — would I dare strike one man wrongly?
translations.idiomatic: Imperial clansman Wang Jianu had deliberately killed Registrar Xianyu; many powerful men sought to save him. The emperor said: “Prince Ying is my elder brother — would I dare lash one man wrongly?

sentences.zh: 朕為人主，敢以無罪害一人乎？

translations.literal: As sovereign, would I dare harm one innocent man?
translations.idiomatic: As sovereign, would I dare harm one innocent man?

sentences.zh: 國家衰弱之際，生靈有幾何，而族子恃殺一主簿，吾民無主矣。

translations.literal: In a time when the state is weakening, how many people do we still have, while a clansman relies on rank to kill one registrar and leave my people without a master?
translations.idiomatic: When the state is weakening, how many people do we still have, while a clansman leans on rank to kill one registrar and leave my people masterless?

sentences.zh: 」特命斬之。

translations.literal: He was specially ordered executed.
translations.idiomatic: He was specially ordered executed.

sentences.zh: 詔有司為死節士十有三人立褒忠廟。

translations.literal: An edict ordered the relevant offices to establish a Loyal-and-Filial Reward shrine for thirteen men who died for principle.
translations.idiomatic: An edict ordered the relevant offices to establish a Loyal-and-Filial Reward shrine for thirteen men who died for principle.

sentences.zh: 禁宿、泗、青口巡邊官兵，毋複擅殺過淮紅衲軍。

translations.literal: Border patrol troops at Su, Si, and Qingkou were forbidden to kill Red-coat troops who crossed the Huai on their own.
translations.idiomatic: Border patrol troops at Su, Si, and Qingkou were forbidden to kill Red-coat troops who crossed the Huai on their own.

sentences.zh: 詔趙秉文、楊雲翼作《龜鏡萬年錄》。

translations.literal: An edict ordered Zhao Bingwen and Yang Yunyi to compile the Mirror-of-the-Tortoise Ten-Thousand-Years Record.
translations.idiomatic: An edict ordered Zhao Bingwen and Yang Yunyi to compile the Mirror-of-the-Tortoise Ten-Thousand-Years Record.

sentences.zh: 三年春正月丁巳朔，夏國遣使來賀。

translations.literal: In the third year, spring, first month, dingsi new moon: Xia sent envoys to offer congratulations.
translations.idiomatic: In the third year, on the first month’s dingsi new moon, Xia sent envoys to offer congratulations.

sentences.zh: 三月，陝西旱。

translations.literal: Third month: Shaanxi suffered drought.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month Shaanxi suffered drought.

sentences.zh: 平章政事胥鼎複請致仕，不許。

translations.literal: Grand Councillor Xu Ding again asked to retire; it was not granted.
translations.idiomatic: Grand Councillor Xu Ding again asked to retire; the request was denied.

sentences.zh: 詔尚書省議省減用度。

translations.literal: An edict ordered the Masters of Writing to discuss cutting expenditures.
translations.idiomatic: An edict ordered the Masters of Writing to discuss cutting expenditures.

sentences.zh: 夏四月辛卯，親享於太廟。

translations.literal: Summer, fourth month, xinmao: the emperor personally offered at the Imperial Ancestral Temple.
translations.idiomatic: In summer, on the fourth month’s xinmao, the emperor personally offered at the Imperial Ancestral Temple.

sentences.zh: 郕國夫人車經禦路，過廟前，馭者乘馬，二婢坐車中，俱不下，詔系獄杖之。

translations.literal: Lady of Xing State Che Jing passed along the imperial road in front of the temple; the driver rode on horseback and two maids sat in the carriage without dismounting — all were ordered imprisoned and beaten.
translations.idiomatic: Lady of Xing State Che Jing took the imperial road past the temple; her driver rode horseback and two maids sat in the carriage without dismounting — all were ordered imprisoned and beaten.

sentences.zh: 辛丑，以旱，遣官禱於濟瀆。

translations.literal: On xinchou, because of drought, officials were sent to pray at the Ji River shrine.
translations.idiomatic: On xinchou, because of drought, officials were sent to pray at the Ji River shrine.

sentences.zh: 癸卯，祈於太廟。

translations.literal: On guimao prayers were offered at the Imperial Ancestral Temple.
translations.idiomatic: On guimao prayers were offered at the Imperial Ancestral Temple.

sentences.zh: 禁傘扇。

translations.literal: Parasol fans were forbidden.
translations.idiomatic: Parasol fans were forbidden.

sentences.zh: 河南大雨雹。

translations.literal: Henan had heavy hail.
translations.idiomatic: Henan was struck by heavy hail.

sentences.zh: 己酉，遣使慮囚，遣使捕蝗。

translations.literal: On jiyou envoys were sent to review prisoners and envoys were sent to catch locusts.
translations.idiomatic: On jiyou envoys were sent to review prisoners and others to catch locusts.

sentences.zh: 五月己未，大雨。

translations.literal: Fifth month, jiwei: heavy rain.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month, on jiwei, heavy rain fell.

sentences.zh: 宋兵掠壽州境。

translations.literal: Song troops raided the border of Shou Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: Song troops raided Shou Prefecture’s border.

sentences.zh: 癸亥，永州桃園軍失利，死者四百人。

translations.literal: On guihai the Yongzhou Peach Garden Army was defeated; four hundred men died.
translations.idiomatic: On guihai the Yongzhou Peach Garden Army was defeated and four hundred men were killed.

sentences.zh: 乙丑，大雨。

translations.literal: On yichou: heavy rain.
translations.idiomatic: On yichou heavy rain fell.

sentences.zh: 壬申，詔諭庾州趙甫等，能以土地來歸，當任使之。

translations.literal: On renshen an edict instructed Zhao Fu and others of Yuzhou that if they could bring their territory in submission, they would be appointed and employed.
translations.idiomatic: On renshen an edict told Zhao Fu and others at Yuzhou that surrendering their lands would win them office.

sentences.zh: 六月辛卯，京東大雨雹，蝗盡死。

translations.literal: Sixth month, xinmao: Jingdong suffered heavy hail; locusts all died.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month, on xinmao, Jingdong was struck by hail; the locusts perished.

sentences.zh: 壬子，詔諭高麗及遼東行省葛不靄，討反賊萬奴，赦脅從者。

translations.literal: On renzi an edict instructed Goryeo and Liaodong Branch Secretariat Gebuai to suppress the rebel Wannu and pardon those coerced to follow him.
translations.idiomatic: On renzi an edict ordered Goryeo and Liaodong commissioner Gebuai to crush rebel Wannu and pardon his compelled followers.

sentences.zh: 秋七月庚午，平章政事英國公胥鼎薨。

translations.literal: Autumn, seventh month, gengwu: Grand Councillor and Duke of Ying Xu Ding died.
translations.idiomatic: In autumn, the seventh month, on gengwu, Grand Councillor and Duke of Ying Xu Ding died.

sentences.zh: 八月，移剌蒲阿複曲沃及晉安。

translations.literal: Eighth month: Yelü Pu'a retook Quwo and Jin'an.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month Yelü Pu'a recovered Quwo and Jin'an.

sentences.zh: 辛卯，詔設益政院於內廷，以禮部尚書楊雲翼等為益政院說書官，日二人直，備顧問。

translations.literal: On xinmao an edict established the Benefit-Governance Institute within the inner court; Minister of Rites Yang Yunyi and others were made its lecturers, two on duty each day to stand ready for consultation.
translations.idiomatic: On xinmao an edict set up the Benefit-Governance Institute in the inner palace; Yang Yunyi of the Ministry of Rites and others became its lecturers, two on daily rotation for consultation.

sentences.zh: 冬十月丁酉，夏使來報哀。

translations.literal: Winter, tenth month, dingyou: a Xia envoy came to report mourning.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth winter month, on dingyou, a Xia envoy arrived announcing a bereavement.

sentences.zh: 十一月庚申，議與宋修好。

translations.literal: Eleventh month, gengshen: the court debated restoring good relations with Song.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month, on gengshen, the court debated peace with Song.

sentences.zh: 戊辰，又議之。

translations.literal: On wuchen the matter was debated again.
translations.idiomatic: On wuchen the court debated it again.

sentences.zh: 己巳，宋忠義軍夏全自楚州來歸，楚州王義深、張惠、范成進以城降，封四人為郡王。

translations.literal: On jisi Xia Quan of Song's Loyalty Army came in from Chuzhou; Wang Yishen, Zhang Hui, and Fan Chengjin of Chuzhou surrendered the city; the four were enfeoffed as princes.
translations.idiomatic: On jisi Xia Quan of Song's Loyalty Army defected from Chuzhou; Wang Yishen, Zhang Hui, and Fan Chengjin surrendered the city; all four were made princes.

sentences.zh: 辛未，改楚州為平淮府，以夏全等來降，赦諸路從宋及淮、楚官吏軍民，並其家屬。

translations.literal: On xinwei Chuzhou was renamed Pacify-Huai Prefecture; because Xia Quan and the rest had submitted, an amnesty was granted to officials, troops, and civilians on every route who had followed Song or were in Huai and Chu, together with their families.
translations.idiomatic: On xinwei Chuzhou became Pacify-Huai Prefecture; with Xia Quan's surrender the throne amnestied officials, soldiers, and people everywhere who had sided with Song or were in Huai and Chu, and their households.

sentences.zh: 甲戌，遣使夏國賀正旦。

translations.literal: On jiaxu envoys were sent to Xia to congratulate the New Year.
translations.idiomatic: On jiaxu the court sent envoys to Xia for New Year greetings.

sentences.zh: 丙子，夏以兵事方殷來報，各停使聘。

translations.literal: On bingzi Xia reported that fighting was still intense and each side suspended envoys and missions.
translations.idiomatic: On bingzi Xia reported active warfare and both courts halted diplomatic exchanges.

sentences.zh: 大元兵征西夏，平中興府。

translations.literal: Great Yuan troops campaigned against Xia and took Zhongxing Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: Great Yuan forces campaigned against Xia and captured Zhongxing Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 召陝西行省及陝州總帥完顏訛可、靈寶總帥紇石烈牙吾塔赴汴議兵事。

translations.literal: The Shaanxi Branch Secretariat and Shaanxi chief commandant Wanyan Eke and Lingbao chief commandant Heshilie Yawuta were summoned to Bian to discuss military affairs.
translations.idiomatic: The Shaanxi branch secretariat and chief commandants Wanyan Eke of Shaanxi and Heshilie Yawuta of Lingbao were called to Bian for a war council.

sentences.zh: 詔諭陝西兩省，凡戎事三品以下官聽以功過賞罰之，銀二十五萬兩從其給賞。

translations.literal: An edict instructed the two Shaanxi circuits that for military affairs officials of third rank and below might reward or punish by merit and fault, with two hundred fifty thousand taels of silver for grants.
translations.idiomatic: An edict told both Shaanxi circuits that in military matters officials through third rank might reward or punish on merit, with two hundred fifty thousand taels of silver for bonuses.

sentences.zh: 遣中奉大夫完顏履信等為弔祭夏國使。

translations.literal: Palace Attendant of the Second Rank Wanyan Lüxin and others were sent as envoys to offer condolences in Xia.
translations.idiomatic: Wanyan Lüxin, palace attendant of the second rank, and others were dispatched to mourn in Xia.

sentences.zh: 四年春正月辛亥朔。

translations.literal: Fourth year, spring, first month, xinhai new moon.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth year, on the first month's xinhai new moon.

sentences.zh: 壬戌，增築中京城，浚汴城外濠。

translations.literal: On renxu the Central Capital was enlarged and the moat outside Bian was dredged.
translations.idiomatic: On renxu the Central Capital walls were extended and the outer moat at Bian was dredged.

sentences.zh: 二月，蒲阿、牙吾塔複平陽，執知府李七斤，獲馬八千。

translations.literal: Second month: Pu'a and Yawuta again recovered Pingyang, seized Prefect Li Qijin, and took eight thousand horses.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month Pu'a and Yawuta retook Pingyang, captured Prefect Li Qijin, and seized eight thousand horses.

sentences.zh: 三月，簽勞效官充軍，有怨言，不果用。

translations.literal: Third month: merit-record officials were tallied to fill the army; there was complaint, and the plan was not carried out.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month the court drafted merit-record officials into service; protests followed and the scheme was dropped.

sentences.zh: 以銀贖平陽虜獲男女，分賜官軍者聽自便。

translations.literal: Captives of both sexes taken at Pingyang might be redeemed with silver; those already distributed to officers and troops might keep them as they wished.
translations.idiomatic: Pingyang captives could be ransomed in silver; those already allotted to the troops could stay with their holders.

sentences.zh: 大元兵平德順府，節度使愛申、攝府判馬肩龍死之。

translations.literal: Great Yuan troops took Deshun Prefecture; Military Commissioner Ai Shen and Acting Prefect Ma Jianlong died in the fighting.
translations.idiomatic: Great Yuan forces captured Deshun; Military Commissioner Ai Shen and Acting Prefect Ma Jianlong were killed.

sentences.zh: 大元兵複下平陽。

translations.literal: Great Yuan troops again took Pingyang.
translations.idiomatic: Great Yuan forces again captured Pingyang.

sentences.zh: 己巳，征夏稅二倍。

translations.literal: On jisi the summer tax was levied at double rate.
translations.idiomatic: On jisi the summer tax was doubled.

sentences.zh: 夏五月丁丑，議乞和於大元。

translations.literal: Summer, fifth month, dingchou: the court debated suing Great Yuan for peace.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth summer month, on dingchou, the court debated seeking peace with Great Yuan.

sentences.zh: 大元兵平臨洮府，總管陀滿胡土門死之。

translations.literal: Great Yuan troops took Lintao Prefecture; Chief Commandant Tuoman Hutumen died in the fighting.
translations.idiomatic: Great Yuan forces captured Lintao; Chief Commandant Tuoman Hutumen was killed.

sentences.zh: 陝西行省進三策：上策自將出戰，中策幸陝州，下策棄秦保潼關。

translations.literal: The Shaanxi Branch Secretariat submitted three plans: the upper plan was for the emperor to take the field in person; the middle plan was to move the court to Shaan Prefecture; the lower plan was to abandon Qin and hold Tong Pass.
translations.idiomatic: The Shaanxi branch secretariat offered three plans: take the field in person; move the court to Shaanzhou; or abandon Qin and hold Tong Pass.

sentences.zh: 不從。

translations.literal: The court did not follow them.
translations.idiomatic: The throne rejected them.

sentences.zh: 六月戊申朔，遣前御史大夫完顏合周為議和使。

translations.literal: Sixth month, wushen new moon: former Censor-in-Chief Wanyan Hezhou was sent as peace negotiator.
translations.idiomatic: On the sixth month's wushen new moon former Censor-in-Chief Wanyan Hezhou was sent to sue for peace.

sentences.zh: 丙辰，地震。

translations.literal: On bingchen there was an earthquake.
translations.idiomatic: On bingchen the earth quaked.

sentences.zh: 太白入井。

translations.literal: Venus entered the Well.
translations.idiomatic: Venus entered the Well constellation.

sentences.zh: 賜詞賦經義盧亞以下進士第。

translations.literal: Jinshi degrees in policy essays and classical exegesis were granted to Lu Ya and those below him.
translations.idiomatic: Lu Ya and the other policy-essay and exegesis jinshi graduates received their degrees.

sentences.zh: 秋七月，大元兵自鳳翔徇京兆，關中大震。

translations.literal: Autumn, seventh month: Great Yuan troops marched from Fengxiang toward Chang'an; Guanzhong was shaken.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh autumn month Great Yuan forces advanced from Fengxiang on Chang'an and threw Guanzhong into alarm.

sentences.zh: 工部尚書師安石為尚書右丞。

translations.literal: Minister of Works Shi Anshi was made Right Vice Director of the Masters of Writing.
translations.idiomatic: Minister of Works Shi Anshi became right vice director of the Masters of Writing.

sentences.zh: 壬辰，以中丞烏古孫卜吉、祭酒裴滿阿虎帶兼司農卿，簽民軍，勸率富民入保城聚，兼督秋稅，令百姓知避遷之計。

translations.literal: On renchen Censor-in-Chief Urgun Buji and Libationer Peiman Ahu dai were also made acting Ministers of Revenue, to enroll militia, urge wealthy households into walled settlements, and oversee the autumn levy so the people would know plans for withdrawal.
translations.idiomatic: On renchen Urgun Buji, censor-in-chief, and libationer Peiman Ahu dai were also named acting ministers of revenue to enroll militia, drive the wealthy into walled towns, and supervise autumn taxes so people knew where to flee.

sentences.zh: 丁酉，赦陝西東、西兩路，賜民今年租。

translations.literal: On dingyou Shaanxi East and West circuits were amnestied and this year's rent was remitted to the people.
translations.idiomatic: On dingyou both Shaanxi circuits received amnesty and this year's rent was forgiven.

sentences.zh: 八月庚戌，詔有司罷遣防備丁壯、修城民夫，軍須差發應不急者權停。

translations.literal: Eighth month, gengxu: an edict ordered offices to dismiss defense conscripts and wall-repair laborers and to suspend non-urgent military requisitions.
translations.idiomatic: On gengxu in the eighth month an edict released defense levies and wall laborers and halted non-urgent military drafts.

sentences.zh: 己巳，萬年節，同知集賢院史公奕進《大定遺訓》，待制呂造進《尚書要略》。

translations.literal: On jisi, the Ten-Thousand-Years festival, Associate Director of the Hall of Gathered Worthies Shi Gongyi presented the Da Ding Legacy Admonitions and Attendant-in-Ordinary Lü Zao presented Essentials of the Documents.
translations.idiomatic: On jisi, the longevity festival, Associate Director Shi Gongyi offered the Da Ding Legacy Admonitions and Attendant Lü Zao offered Essentials of the Documents.

sentences.zh: 是日，大風落左掖門鴟尾，壞丹鳳扉。

translations.literal: That day a great wind blew the rooftop ornament from the left side gate and damaged the Danfeng doors.
translations.idiomatic: That day a gale tore the finial from the left side gate and wrecked the Danfeng doors.

sentences.zh: 隕霜，禾盡損。

translations.literal: Frost fell and the grain crop was ruined.
translations.idiomatic: Frost struck and the crops were lost.

sentences.zh: 李全自都複入楚州據之，遣總帥完顏訛可、元帥慶山奴守盱眙，與全戰於龜山，敗績。

translations.literal: Li Quan returned from the capital and again seized Chuzhou; Chief Commandant Wanyan Eke and Marshal Qingshannu were posted to guard Xuyi and fought Li Quan at Guishan; they were defeated.
translations.idiomatic: Li Quan came back from court, reoccupied Chuzhou, and beat the government force under Wanyan Eke and Marshal Qingshannu at Guishan after they tried to hold Xuyi.

sentences.zh: 冬十月辛酉，右拾遺李大節、右司諫陳規劾同判睦親府事撒合輦奸贓，不報。

translations.literal: Winter, tenth month, xinyou: Right Remonstrance Office censor Li Dajie and Right Secretariat remonstrance official Chen Gui impeached Associate Commissioner of the Imperial Clan Office Sahelian for corruption; no reply was given.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth winter month, on xinyou, Right Remonstrance censor Li Dajie and Right Secretariat remonstrator Chen Gui charged Sahelian of the Imperial Clan Office with graft; the court did not answer.

sentences.zh: 壬戌，外台監察禦史諫獵，上怒，以邀名賣直責之。

translations.literal: On renxu an outer-route surveillance censor remonstrated against the hunt; the emperor was angry and rebuked him for courting a reputation and selling integrity.
translations.idiomatic: On renxu a circuit censor protested the hunt; the emperor raged and accused him of chasing fame and peddling integrity.

sentences.zh: 詔贈德順府死事愛申、馬肩龍等官。

translations.literal: An edict granted posthumous office to Ai Shen, Ma Jianlong, and others who died for Deshun Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: An edict posthumously honored Ai Shen, Ma Jianlong, and the other Deshun dead.

sentences.zh: 以淮南王爵招李全。

translations.literal: The title Prince of Huainan was offered to win over Li Quan.
translations.idiomatic: The throne offered Li Quan the Prince of Huainan title to bring him in.

sentences.zh: 十一月乙未，未時，日上有二白虹貫之。

translations.literal: Eleventh month, yiwei, at the wei hour: two white rainbows pierced the sun.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month, on yiwei at the wei hour, two white rainbows cut across the sun.

sentences.zh: 丁酉，獵於近郊。

translations.literal: On dingyou he hunted in the near suburbs.
translations.idiomatic: On dingyou he hunted near the capital.

sentences.zh: 十二月，真授李蹊參知政事。

translations.literal: Twelfth month: Li Xi was formally appointed Participation Councillor.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month Li Xi was confirmed as participation councillor.

sentences.zh: 大元兵下商州。

translations.literal: Great Yuan troops took Shang Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: Great Yuan forces captured Shang Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 壬子，遣使安撫陝西，以牛千頭賜貧民。

translations.literal: On renzi envoys were dispatched to soothe Shaanxi; a thousand head of cattle were bestowed on the destitute.
translations.idiomatic: On renzi the court sent envoys to pacify Shaanxi and gave a thousand cattle to the poor.

sentences.zh: 五年春正月丁丑，親祭三廟。

translations.literal: Fifth year, spring, first month, on dingchou: the emperor personally sacrificed at the Three Temples.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth year, spring, first month, on dingchou, the emperor sacrificed in person at the Three Temples.

sentences.zh: 庚辰，遣知開封府事完顏麻斤出如大元吊慰。

translations.literal: On gengchen Wanyan Maqin, who knew Kaifeng prefecture affairs, was sent out to Great Yuan to offer condolences.
translations.idiomatic: On gengchen Wanyan Maqin, intendant of Kaifeng prefecture, was dispatched to Great Yuan with condolences.

sentences.zh: 丙戌，議擊盱眙。

translations.literal: On bingxu they deliberated attacking Xuyi.
translations.idiomatic: On bingxu the court debated an attack on Xuyi.

sentences.zh: 辛卯，以龜山之敗，降元帥慶山奴為定國軍節度使。

translations.literal: On xinmao, because of defeat at Guishan, Marshal Qingshan Nu was demoted to Dingguo Army Military Commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: On xinmao, after defeat at Guishan, Marshal Qingshan Nu was reduced to Dingguo Army commissioner.

sentences.zh: 二月乙巳朔，大寒，雷，雨雪，木之華者盡死。

translations.literal: Second month, yisi new moon: extreme cold, thunder, rain and snow — trees in bloom all died.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month, on the yisi new moon, bitter cold brought thunder, rain, and snow, and flowering trees perished.

sentences.zh: 癸丑，詔有司以臨洮總管陀滿胡土門塑像入褒忠廟。

translations.literal: On guichou an edict ordered offices to install a statue of Lintao commander Tuoman Hutumen in the Reward-Loyalty Temple.
translations.idiomatic: On guichou an edict told offices to place a statue of Lintao commander Tuoman Hutumen in the Reward-Loyalty Temple.

sentences.zh: 書死節子孫于禦屏，量材官使之。

translations.literal: The names of die-for-duty descendants were inscribed on the Imperial Screen; offices were to assign posts suited to their talents.
translations.idiomatic: Names of their descendants who died in service were entered on the Imperial Screen, and offices were to employ them by ability.

sentences.zh: 五月癸巳，定國軍節度使慶山奴以受賂，奪一官。

translations.literal: Fifth month, guisi: Dingguo Army Commissioner Qingshan Nu, for taking bribes, had one rank stripped.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month, on guisi, Dingguo Army commissioner Qingshan Nu lost one rank for accepting bribes.

sentences.zh: 六月壬戌，以旱，赦雜犯罪死已下。

translations.literal: Sixth month, on renxu, because of drought, miscellaneous crimes short of death were pardoned.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month, on renxu, drought brought an amnesty for miscellaneous crimes below capital punishment.

sentences.zh: 秋七月戊子，同判睦親府事撒合輦出為中京留寧，行樞密院事。

translations.literal: Autumn, seventh month, on wuzi: Associate Administrator of the Kindred-Relations Bureau Sahelian was sent out as Middle Capital garrison-chief, exercising Privy Council affairs.
translations.idiomatic: In autumn, the seventh month, on wuzi, Kindred-Relations associate administrator Sahelian went out as Middle Capital garrison chief with Privy Council authority.

sentences.zh: 八月乙卯，以旱，遣使禱于上清宮。

translations.literal: Eighth month, on yimao, because of drought, envoys were sent to pray at the Upper Clarity Palace.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month, on yimao, drought led to envoys praying at the Upper Clarity Palace.

sentences.zh: 甲子，參知政事白撒為尚書右丞，太常卿顏盞世魯權參知政事。

translations.literal: On jiazi Participation Councillor Bai Sa became Right Vice Director of the Department of State; Court of Imperial Sacrifices Director Yanshan Shilu was acting Participation Councillor.
translations.idiomatic: On jiazi Participation Councillor Bai Sa became Right Vice Director of State; Court of Imperial Sacrifices director Yanshan Shilu was acting Participation Councillor.

sentences.zh: 增築歸德行樞密院，擬工役數百萬，詔遣權樞密院判官白華喻以農夫勞苦，減其工三之二。

translations.literal: They enlarged the Guide traveling Privy Council installation, planning millions in labor — an edict sent acting Privy Council Judge Bai Hua to explain peasants' hardships and cut the work by two-thirds.
translations.idiomatic: The Guide traveling Privy Council was expanded with millions in corvée planned; an edict sent acting Privy Council judge Bai Hua to cite farmers' hardship and cut labor by two-thirds.

sentences.zh: 以節制不一，並衛州帥府於恆山公府，命白華往經畫之。

translations.literal: Because command was not unified, the Weizhou command headquarters was merged with the Duke of Hengshan's headquarters; Bai Hua was ordered to go plan it.
translations.idiomatic: With command divided, the Weizhou command was folded into the Duke of Hengshan's headquarters and Bai Hua was sent to arrange it.

sentences.zh: 九月庚寅，雨足，始種麥。

translations.literal: Ninth month, on gengyin: rain was sufficient and wheat planting began.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month, on gengyin, rain was enough and wheat sowing started.

sentences.zh: 冬十一月辛巳，進宣《宣宗實錄》。

translations.literal: Winter, eleventh month, on xinsi: the Veritable Record of Xuanzong was presented and proclaimed.
translations.idiomatic: In winter, the eleventh month, on xinsi, the Veritable Record of Xuanzong was presented to the throne.

sentences.zh: 十二月庚子朔，日有食之。

translations.literal: Twelfth month, gengzi new moon: there was a solar eclipse.
translations.idiomatic: On the twelfth month's gengzi new moon the sun was eclipsed.

sentences.zh: 完顏麻斤出以奉使不職，免死除名。

translations.literal: Wanyan Maqin, returned from his mission, for dereliction as envoy was spared death but struck from the rolls.
translations.idiomatic: Wanyan Maqin, back from abroad, was spared execution for failing his mission but removed from office.

sentences.zh: 壬子，完顏奴申改侍講學士，充國信使。

translations.literal: On renzi Wanyan Nushen was changed to Attendant Lecturer and made credentialed envoy.
translations.idiomatic: On renzi Wanyan Nushen became Attendant Lecturer and was made credentialed envoy.

sentences.zh: 以陝西大寒，賜軍士柴炭銀有差。

translations.literal: Because Shaanxi suffered extreme cold, firewood, charcoal, and silver were granted to troops in varying measure.
translations.idiomatic: With Shaanxi in bitter cold, troops received firewood, charcoal, and silver in graded amounts.

sentences.zh: 京兆、鳳翔府司竹監進竹，令分給之。

translations.literal: The bamboo commissioners of Jingzhao and Fengxiang prefectures presented bamboo; an order had it distributed to them.
translations.idiomatic: Jingzhao and Fengxiang bamboo offices sent bamboo, and an order had it shared among the troops.

sentences.zh: 六年春二月丙辰，樞密院判官移剌蒲阿權樞密副使。

translations.literal: Sixth year, spring, second month, on bingchen: Privy Council Judge Yila Pu'a was acting Vice Director of the Privy Council.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth year, spring, second month, on bingchen, Privy Council judge Yila Pu'a was acting vice director of the Privy Council.

sentences.zh: 耀州刺史李興有戰功，詔賜玉兔鶻帶、金器。

translations.literal: Yaozhou Prefect Li Xing had military merit; an edict granted a jade hare with gyrfalcon belt and gold vessels.
translations.idiomatic: Yaozhou prefect Li Xing had battle merit; an edict gave him a jade hare-and-gyrfalcon belt and gold vessels.

sentences.zh: 以丞相完顏賽不行尚書省事於關中，召平章政事完顏合達還朝。

translations.literal: Because Chancellor Wanyan Saibu would not go exercise Department of State affairs in Guanzhong, Participation Councillor Wanyan Heda was recalled to court.
translations.idiomatic: As Chancellor Wanyan Saibu would not take up Department affairs in Guanzhong, Participation Councillor Wanyan Heda was recalled.

sentences.zh: 移剌蒲阿率忠孝軍總領完顏陳和尚忠孝軍一千騎駐邠州。

translations.literal: Yila Pu'a led Loyal-and-Filial Army chief Wanyan Chen Heshang's thousand Loyal-and-Filial cavalry to garrison at Bin Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: Yila Pu'a led a thousand Loyal-and-Filial cavalry under chief Wanyan Chen Heshang to camp at Bin Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 遣白華馳諭蒲阿以用兵之意。

translations.literal: Bai Hua was sent post-haste to explain to Pu'a the intent of deploying troops.
translations.idiomatic: Bai Hua was rushed out to tell Pu'a the plan for using troops.

sentences.zh: 詔樞密更給忠孝軍馬疋，以漸調發都尉司步卒及忠孝馬軍屯京西。

translations.literal: An edict ordered the Privy Council to reissue horses to the Loyal-and-Filial Army and gradually call up Metropolitan Guard infantry and Loyal-and-Filial cavalry to camp in western Jing.
translations.idiomatic: An edict told the Privy Council to replace Loyal-and-Filial horses and slowly move Metropolitan Guard foot and Loyal-and-Filial horse troops to western Jing.

sentences.zh: 以白華專備軍須。

translations.literal: Bai Hua was put solely in charge of military supplies.
translations.idiomatic: Bai Hua was assigned exclusively to military logistics.

sentences.zh: 三月乙亥，忠孝軍總領陳和尚有戰功，授定遠大將軍、平涼府判官，世襲謀克。

translations.literal: Third month, on yihai: Loyal-and-Filial Army chief Chen Heshang had battle merit; he was made General Who Settles the Distance, Pingliang Prefecture judge, with hereditary meng'an.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month, on yihai, Loyal-and-Filial chief Chen Heshang won merit and was made General Who Settles the Distance, Pingliang prefectural judge, with hereditary meng'an.

sentences.zh: 夏五月，隴州防禦使石抹冬兒進黃鸚鵡，詔曰：「外方獻珍禽異獸，違物性，損人力，令勿複進。

translations.literal: Summer, fifth month: Long Prefecture Defense Commissioner Shimao Dong'er presented a yellow parrot; an edict said, "When outer regions present rare birds and beasts, it goes against their nature and wastes manpower — let such tribute not be brought again.
translations.idiomatic: In summer, the fifth month, Long Defense Commissioner Shimao Dong'er sent a yellow parrot; an edict said, "Tribute of rare birds and beasts from afar violates their nature and burdens the people — do not present them again.

sentences.zh: 」秋七月，罷陝西行省軍中浮費。

translations.literal: " Autumn, seventh month: wasteful spending in the Shaanxi Traveling Secretariat army was abolished.
translations.idiomatic: " In autumn, the seventh month, wasteful costs in the Shaanxi traveling army were cut.

sentences.zh: 八月，移剌蒲阿再複澤、潞。

translations.literal: Eighth month: Yila Pu'a again recovered Ze and Lu.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month Yila Pu'a retook Ze and Lu.

sentences.zh: 九月，洮、河、蘭、會元帥顏盞蝦鲩麻進西馬二疋，詔曰：「卿武藝超絕，此馬可充戰用，朕乘豈能盡其力。

translations.literal: Ninth month: Military commissioners of Tao, He, Lan, and Hui — Yanshan Xiamo — presented two western horses; an edict said, "Your martial skill is outstanding; this horse can serve in battle — how could my riding exhaust its strength?
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month Tao, He, Lan, and Hui commissioner Yanshan Xiamo offered two western horses; an edict said, "Your fighting skill is superb; this horse belongs in battle — how could I as rider use up its power?

sentences.zh: 既入進，即尚廄物也，今以賜卿，其悉朕意。

translations.literal: Once presented, it is imperial-stable property; now it is bestowed on you — understand my intent."
translations.idiomatic: Once offered it is imperial stable stock; now I give it to you — grasp my meaning."

sentences.zh: 」冬十月，移剌蒲阿東還，令陳和尚率陝西歸順馬軍屯鈞、許。

translations.literal: " Winter, tenth month: Yila Pu'a returned east; Chen Heshang was ordered to lead Shaanxi surrender cavalry to garrison at Jun and Xu.
translations.idiomatic: " In winter, the tenth month, Yila Pu'a marched back east and Chen Heshang was told to station Shaanxi submitted horse troops at Jun and Xu.

sentences.zh: 大元兵駐慶陽界。

translations.literal: Great Yuan troops encamped on the Qingyang border.
translations.idiomatic: Great Yuan forces camped on the Qingyang frontier.

sentences.zh: 詔陝西行省遣使奉羊酒幣帛乞緩師請和。

translations.literal: An edict ordered the Shaanxi Traveling Secretariat to send envoys with sheep, wine, silk, and cloth to beg a pause in campaigning and seek peace.
translations.idiomatic: An edict told the Shaanxi traveling secretariat to send envoys with sheep, wine, and gifts to ask for a truce and peace.

sentences.zh: 十一月，遣使鈞、許選試陝西歸順人，得軍二千，以藝優者充忠孝軍，次充合裏合軍。

translations.literal: Eleventh month: envoys were sent to Jun and Xu to test Shaanxi surrenderers; two thousand troops were obtained — the most skilled filled the Loyal-and-Filial Army, the rest the Helihe Army.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month envoys at Jun and Xu tested Shaanxi submitters and raised two thousand men — the best joined the Loyal-and-Filial Army, the rest the Helihe Army.

sentences.zh: 十二月，詔副樞蒲阿、總帥紇石烈牙吾塔、權簽樞密院事完顏訛可救慶陽。

translations.literal: Twelfth month: an edict ordered Vice Director Pu'a, Commander-in-Chief Hesheli Yawuta, and acting Privy Council signatory Wanyan Eke to relieve Qingyang.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month an edict sent Vice Director Pu'a, Commander-in-Chief Hesheli Yawuta, and acting signatory Wanyan Eke to rescue Qingyang.

sentences.zh: 罷附京獵地百里，聽民耕稼。

translations.literal: Hunting grounds within a hundred li of the capital were abolished; the people were allowed to farm.
translations.idiomatic: Capital hunting reserves for a hundred li were ended and farming was permitted.

sentences.zh: 七年春正月，副樞蒲阿、總帥牙吾塔、權簽院事訛可解慶陽之圍。

translations.literal: Seventh year, spring, first month: Vice Director Pu'a, Commander-in-Chief Yawuta, and acting signatory Eke lifted the siege of Qingyang.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh year, spring, first month, Vice Director Pu'a, Commander-in-Chief Yawuta, and acting signatory Eke broke the Qingyang siege.

sentences.zh: 以訛可屯邠州，蒲阿、牙吾塔還京兆。

translations.literal: Eke was stationed at Bin; Pu'a and Yawuta returned to Jingzhao.
translations.idiomatic: Eke held Bin Prefecture while Pu'a and Yawuta returned to Jingzhao.

sentences.zh: 夏五月，詔釋清口宋敗軍三千人，願留者五百人，以屯許州，餘悉縱遣之。

translations.literal: Summer, fifth month: an edict released three thousand Song troops defeated at Qingkou; five hundred who wished to stay were kept to garrison Xu Prefecture, the rest were all sent away.
translations.idiomatic: In summer, the fifth month, three thousand Song soldiers beaten at Qingkou were freed; five hundred who chose to remain garrisoned Xu Prefecture and the rest were sent home.

sentences.zh: 賜經義詞賦李瑭以下進士第。

translations.literal: Li Tang and others in the classical-meaning and lyric-exam categories were granted jinshi rank.
translations.idiomatic: Li Tang and others in the classics and fu examinations received jinshi degrees.

sentences.zh: 秋七月，以平章政事合達權樞密副使。

translations.literal: Autumn, seventh month: Participation Councillor Heda was made acting Vice Director of the Privy Council.
translations.idiomatic: In autumn, the seventh month, Participation Councillor Heda became acting Privy Council vice director.

sentences.zh: 八月，賜陝西死事孤鹽引及絹，仍量材任使。

translations.literal: Eighth month: orphans of those who died for duty in Shaanxi were given salt coupons and silk, and still assigned posts by talent.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month Shaanxi orphans of the war dead received salt tickets and silk and were placed in office by ability.

sentences.zh: 大元兵圍武仙于舊衛州。

translations.literal: Great Yuan troops besieged Wu Xian at Old Weizhou.
translations.idiomatic: Great Yuan forces besieged Wu Xian at Old Weizhou.

sentences.zh: 冬十月，平章合達、副樞蒲阿引兵救衛州。

translations.literal: Winter, tenth month: Participation Councillor Heda and Vice Director Pu'a led troops to relieve Weizhou.
translations.idiomatic: In winter, the tenth month, Participation Councillor Heda and Vice Director Pu'a marched to relieve Weizhou.

sentences.zh: 衛州圍解，上登承天門犒軍，合達、蒲阿並世襲謀克。

translations.literal: The Weizhou siege was lifted; the emperor mounted Chengtian Gate to reward the army; Heda and Pu'a were each given hereditary meng'an.
translations.idiomatic: Weizhou was saved; the emperor went up Chengtian Gate to feast the troops; Heda and Pu'a each received hereditary meng'an.

sentences.zh: 移剌蒲阿權參政事，同合達行省事於閿鄉，以備潼關。

translations.literal: Yila Pu'a was acting Participation Councillor and, with Heda, exercised traveling Secretariat affairs at Wenxiang to guard Tong Pass.
translations.idiomatic: Yila Pu'a became acting Participation Councillor and, with Heda, ran the mobile Secretariat at Wenxiang against Tong Pass.

sentences.zh: 八年春正月，大元兵圍鳳翔府。

translations.literal: Eighth year, spring, first month: Great Yuan troops besieged Fengxiang Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth year, spring, first month, Great Yuan forces besieged Fengxiang Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 遣樞密院判官白華、右司郎中夾谷八裏門諭閿鄉行省進兵，合達、蒲阿以未見機會不行。

translations.literal: Privy Council Judge Bai Hua and Right Secretariat Director Jiagu Balimen were sent to instruct the Wenxiang traveling secretariat to advance; Heda and Pu'a, seeing no opportunity, did not move.
translations.idiomatic: Privy Council judge Bai Hua and Right Secretariat director Jiagu Balimen were sent to order the Wenxiang secretariat forward; Heda and Pu'a held back for lack of a chance.

sentences.zh: 複遣白華諭合達、蒲達將兵出關以解鳳翔之圍，又不行。

translations.literal: Bai Hua was again sent to tell Heda and Pu'a to lead troops out of the pass to lift the Fengxiang siege — again they did not move.
translations.idiomatic: Bai Hua was sent again to urge Heda and Pu'a out of the pass to relieve Fengxiang, and again they stayed put.

sentences.zh: 夏四月丁巳朔，赦。

translations.literal: Summer, fourth month, dingsi new moon: an amnesty was proclaimed.
translations.idiomatic: In summer, on the fourth month's dingsi new moon, the court proclaimed an amnesty.

sentences.zh: 全免京西路軍錢一年。

translations.literal: All Jingxi Route army money was remitted for one year.
translations.idiomatic: Jingxi Route military levies were waived for the full year.

sentences.zh: 旱災州縣，差稅從實減貸。

translations.literal: In drought-stricken prefectures and counties, land tax was reduced and lent according to actual conditions.
translations.idiomatic: In drought-hit districts, land tax was cut and relief loans were scaled to local need.

sentences.zh: 大元兵平鳳翔府。

translations.literal: Great Yuan troops took Fengxiang Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: Great Yuan forces captured Fengxiang Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 兩行省棄京兆，遷居民于河南，留慶山奴守之。

translations.literal: The two traveling secretariats abandoned Chang'an, moved the populace to Henan, and left Qingshan Nu to hold it.
translations.idiomatic: Both traveling secretariats quit Chang'an, relocated the people to Henan, and left Qingshan Nu on guard.

sentences.zh: 五月，李全妻楊妙真以全陷沒于宋，構浮梁楚州北，欲複宋讎。

translations.literal: Fifth month: Li Quan's wife Yang Miaozhen, because Quan had been lost to Song, built a pontoon bridge north of Chuzhou to avenge Song.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month Yang Miaozhen, Li Quan's wife — Quan having fallen to Song — built a floating bridge north of Chuzhou to strike back at Song.

sentences.zh: 遣合達、蒲阿屯桃源界滶河口，以備侵軼。

translations.literal: Heda and Pu'a were ordered to camp at the Taoyuan boundary on the Miao River mouth to guard against raids.
translations.idiomatic: Heda and Pu'a were told to encamp at Taoyuan on the Miao River mouth to block incursions.

sentences.zh: 宋八裏莊人拒其主將納合達、蒲阿。

translations.literal: People of Song's Balizhuang rejected their commander Naheda, Heda, and Pu'a.
translations.idiomatic: Balizhuang in Song territory turned away its commander Naheda along with Heda and Pu'a.

sentences.zh: 詔改八裏莊為鎮淮府。

translations.literal: An edict renamed Balizhuang Zhenhuai Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: An edict made Balizhuang Zhenhuai Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 秋七月，宋將焚浮梁。

translations.literal: Autumn, seventh month: Song generals burned the pontoon bridge.
translations.idiomatic: In autumn, the seventh month, Song troops burned the floating bridge.

sentences.zh: 九月丙申，慈聖宮皇太后溫敦氏崩，遣誥園陵制度務從儉約。

translations.literal: Ninth month, bingshen: Benevolent-Sage Palace Empress Dowager of the Wendun clan died; an edict ordered the mausoleum rites kept frugal.
translations.idiomatic: On the ninth month's bingshen the Benevolent-Sage Palace empress dowager of the Wendun clan died; an edict required spare funeral arrangements.

sentences.zh: 大元兵駐河中府。

translations.literal: Great Yuan troops were stationed at Hezhong Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: Great Yuan forces camped at Hezhong Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 慶山奴棄京兆東還。

translations.literal: Qingshan Nu abandoned Chang'an and marched back east.
translations.idiomatic: Qingshan Nu gave up Chang'an and withdrew east.

sentences.zh: 召合達、蒲阿赴汴，議引兵趨河中府，懼不敢行，還陝州，出師至冷水穀而歸。

translations.literal: Heda and Pu'a were summoned to Bian to discuss leading troops toward Hezhong; fearing to go, they returned to Shaan Prefecture, marched out to Cold Water Valley, and came back.
translations.idiomatic: Heda and Pu'a were called to Bian to plan a march on Hezhong; afraid to proceed, they went back to Shaan Prefecture, sortied to Cold Water Valley, and returned.

sentences.zh: 大元兵攻河中府，合達、蒲阿遣元帥王敢率兵萬人救之。

translations.literal: Great Yuan troops attacked Hezhong Prefecture; Heda and Pu'a sent Marshal Wang Gan with ten thousand men to relieve it.
translations.idiomatic: As Great Yuan forces assaulted Hezhong, Heda and Pu'a dispatched Marshal Wang Gan with ten thousand troops to its aid.

sentences.zh: 冬十月，右丞相賽不致仕。

translations.literal: Winter, tenth month: Right Chancellor Saibu retired from office.
translations.idiomatic: In winter, the tenth month, Right Chancellor Saibu left office.

sentences.zh: 十一月丁未，大元進兵嶢峰關，由金州而東。

translations.literal: Eleventh month, dingwei: Great Yuan advanced on Yaofeng Pass and came east through Jin Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: On the eleventh month's dingwei Great Yuan troops pressed Yaofeng Pass and moved east by way of Jin Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 省院議以逸侍勞，未可與戰。

translations.literal: The Secretariat and Privy Council debated waiting at ease to weary the enemy and judged battle inadvisable.
translations.idiomatic: Secretariat and Privy Council argued to rest the army and wear the foe down, and held that fighting was premature.

sentences.zh: 上諭之曰：「南渡二十年，所在之民，破田宅，鬻妻子，竭肝腦以養軍。

translations.literal: The emperor instructed them, saying: "In the twenty years since the southern crossing, people everywhere have ruined fields and homes, sold wives and children, and poured out heart and liver to feed the armies.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor told them: "Twenty years since we crossed south, the people have wrecked farms and houses, sold wives and children, and drained themselves to sustain the army.

sentences.zh: 今兵至不能逆戰，止以自護，京城縱存，何以為國，天下其謂我何？

translations.literal: Now when the enemy comes you will not meet them in battle but only protect yourselves — even if the capital survives, how is that a state? What will the realm say of me?
translations.idiomatic: Now the foe is here and you refuse to fight, only to shield yourselves — if the capital alone endures, what state remains, and what will the world think of me?

sentences.zh: 朕思之熟矣，存與亡有天命，惟不負吾民可也。

translations.literal: I have thought this through: life and death are Heaven's decree; only not failing our people matters."
translations.idiomatic: I have weighed it long: survival and ruin lie with fate; all I ask is not to betray our people."

sentences.zh: 」乃詔諸將屯軍襄、鄧。

translations.literal: An edict then ordered the generals to encamp at Xiang and Deng.
translations.idiomatic: An edict then told the generals to station at Xiang and Deng.

sentences.zh: 十二月己未，葬明惠皇后。

translations.literal: Twelfth month, jiwei: Empress Minghui was buried.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month, on jiwei, Empress Minghui was interred.

sentences.zh: 河中府破，權簽樞密院事草火訛可死之，元帥板子訛可提敗卒三千走閿鄉。

translations.literal: Hezhong Prefecture fell; acting Privy Council signatory Caohuo Eke died in the fighting; Marshal Banzi Eke led three thousand beaten troops in flight to Wenxiang.
translations.idiomatic: Hezhong fell; acting signatory Caohuo Eke died in battle; Marshal Banzi Eke fled to Wenxiang with three thousand survivors.

sentences.zh: 詔赦將佐以下，杖訛可二百以死。

translations.literal: An edict pardoned officers and men below that rank but sentenced Banzi Eke to two hundred strokes of the staff unto death.
translations.idiomatic: An edict spared subordinate officers and troops but ordered Banzi Eke beaten two hundred times with the staff until dead.

sentences.zh: 合達、蒲阿率諸軍入鄧州，楊沃衍、陳和尚、武仙皆引兵來會。

translations.literal: Heda and Pu'a led the armies into Deng Prefecture; Yang Woyan, Chen Heshang, and Wu Xian all brought troops to join them.
translations.idiomatic: Heda and Pu'a entered Deng Prefecture with their forces; Yang Woyan, Chen Heshang, and Wu Xian each marched in to rendezvous.

sentences.zh: 出屯順陽。

translations.literal: They went out and encamped at Shunyang.
translations.idiomatic: They moved out and camped at Shunyang.

sentences.zh: 戊辰，大元兵渡漢江而北，丙子，畢渡。

translations.literal: On wuchen Great Yuan troops crossed the Han River northward; on bingzi the crossing was complete.
translations.idiomatic: On wuchen Great Yuan forces crossed the Han heading north; on bingzi the passage was finished.

sentences.zh: 合達、蒲阿將兵禦于禹山之前。

translations.literal: Heda and Pu'a led troops to resist before Mount Yu.
translations.idiomatic: Heda and Pu'a took the army to block them before Mount Yu.

sentences.zh: 大元兵分道趨汴京，京城戒嚴。

translations.literal: Great Yuan troops split columns toward Bianjing; the capital was placed under alert.
translations.idiomatic: Great Yuan columns pressed on Bianjing and the capital went on full guard.

sentences.zh: 是夜二鼓，合達、蒲阿引軍還鄧州。

translations.literal: That night at the second watch Heda and Pu'a led the army back to Deng Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: That night at the second watch Heda and Pu'a withdrew the army to Deng Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 大元兵躡其後，盡獲其輜重。

translations.literal: Great Yuan troops followed behind and seized all their baggage train.
translations.idiomatic: Great Yuan forces pursued and captured their entire supply train.

sentences.zh: 天興元年，是年本正大九年，正月改元開興，四月又改元天興。

translations.literal: First year of Tianxing — that year had been the ninth year of Zhengda; in the first month the era was changed to Kaixing, and in the fourth month again changed to Tianxing.
translations.idiomatic: The first Tianxing year — still Zhengda year 9 — saw the era renamed Kaixing in the first month and Tianxing in the fourth.

sentences.zh: 春正月壬午朔，日有兩珥。

translations.literal: Spring, first month, renwu new moon: the sun showed double ear-rings.
translations.idiomatic: In spring, on the first month's renwu new moon, the sun bore twin ear-shaped halos.

sentences.zh: 大元兵道唐州，元帥完顏兩婁室與戰襄城之汝墳，敗績。

translations.literal: Great Yuan troops passed Tang Prefecture; Marshal Wanyan Liangloushi fought them at Rufen in Xiangcheng and was defeated.
translations.idiomatic: Great Yuan forces marched through Tang Prefecture; Marshal Wanyan Liangloushi met them at Rufen in Xiangcheng and lost.

sentences.zh: 兩婁室走汴京。

translations.literal: Liangloushi fled to Bianjing.
translations.idiomatic: Liangloushi ran to Bianjing.

sentences.zh: 遣完顏麻斤出等部民丁萬人，決河水衛京城。

translations.literal: Wanyan Majin and others were sent to muster ten thousand local militia and cut the river to defend the capital.
translations.idiomatic: Wanyan Majin and others were ordered to raise ten thousand militia and breach the river to shield the capital.

sentences.zh: 癸未，置尚書省、樞密院于宮中，以便召問。

translations.literal: On guimao the Department of State and Privy Council were placed within the palace for ready consultation.
translations.idiomatic: On guimao the Department of State and Privy Council were set up inside the palace for quick access.

sentences.zh: 起前元帥古裏甲石倫權昌武軍節度使，行元帥府事。

translations.literal: Former Marshal Gulijia Shilun was raised as acting Changwu Army Military Commissioner, exercising marshalate affairs.
translations.idiomatic: Former marshal Gulijia Shilun was recalled as acting Changwu Army commissioner with marshalate authority.

sentences.zh: 合達、蒲阿引軍自鄧州赴汴京。

translations.literal: Heda and Pu'a led their army from Deng Prefecture toward Bianjing.
translations.idiomatic: Heda and Pu'a marched from Deng Prefecture toward Bianjing.

sentences.zh: 乙酉，以點檢夾穀撒合為總帥，將步騎三萬巡河渡，權近侍局使徒單長樂監其軍。

translations.literal: On yiyou Palace Inspector Jiagu Sahe was made supreme commander with thirty thousand foot and horse to patrol the river crossings; Acting Director of the Inner Service Bureau Tushan Changle supervised the army.
translations.idiomatic: On yiyou palace inspector Jiagu Sahe became supreme commander of thirty thousand infantry and cavalry to patrol the fords, with acting inner-service director Tushan Changle overseeing the force.

sentences.zh: 起近京諸色軍家屬五十萬口入京。

translations.literal: Families of all military households near the capital — five hundred thousand persons — were moved into the city.
translations.idiomatic: Kin of every capital-region military household, five hundred thousand people, were brought into the city.

sentences.zh: 丙戌，大元兵既定河中，由河清縣白坡渡河。

translations.literal: On bingxu, once Great Yuan had secured Hezhong, they crossed from Heqing County's Baipo ford.
translations.idiomatic: On bingxu, with Hezhong in hand, Great Yuan crossed at Baipo ford in Heqing County.

sentences.zh: 丁亥，長樂、撒合引兵至封丘而還。

translations.literal: On dinghai Changle and Sahe led troops to Fengqiu and returned.
translations.idiomatic: On dinghai Changle and Sahe advanced to Fengqiu and came back.

sentences.zh: 戊子，左司郎中斜卯愛實上書請斬長樂、撒合以肅軍政，不從。

translations.literal: On wuzi Left Secretariat Director Xiemao Aishi memorialized asking that Changle and Sahe be executed to stiffen military discipline — the request was denied.
translations.idiomatic: On wuzi left director Xiemao Aishi asked that Changle and Sahe be put to death to restore army discipline; the throne refused.

sentences.zh: 都尉烏林答胡土一軍自潼關入援，至偃師，聞大元兵渡河，遂走登封少室山。

translations.literal: Commandant Wulinda Hutu's army came from Tong Pass to reinforce; reaching Yanshi, hearing Great Yuan had crossed the river, he fled to Dengfeng's Shaoshi Mountain.
translations.idiomatic: Commandant Wulinda Hutu marched from Tong Pass to aid the capital; at Yanshi, learning Great Yuan had crossed, he fled to Shaoshi Mountain in Dengfeng.

sentences.zh: 壬辰，衛州節度使完顏斜撚阿不棄城走汴。

translations.literal: On renchen, Weizhou Military Commissioner Wanyan Xienian Abo abandoned the city and fled to Bian.
translations.idiomatic: On renchen Weizhou commissioner Wanyan Xienian Abo deserted his post and fled to Bian.

sentences.zh: 甲午，修京城樓櫓及守禦備。

translations.literal: On jiawu, the capital's towers, parapets, and defensive stores were repaired.
translations.idiomatic: On jiawu the capital's towers, parapets, and siege stores were repaired.

sentences.zh: 大元兵薄鄭州，與白坡兵合，屯軍元帥馬伯堅以城降，防禦使烏林答咬住死之。

translations.literal: Great Yuan troops pressed Zhengzhou, joined the Baipo force, and encamped; Marshal Ma Bojian surrendered the city, and Defense Commissioner Ulinada Yaozhu died in the fighting.
translations.idiomatic: Great Yuan forces closed on Zhengzhou, united with troops at Baipo, and camped; Marshal Ma Bojian surrendered the city and Defense Commissioner Ulinada Yaozhu was killed.

sentences.zh: 乙未，大元遊騎至汴城。

translations.literal: On yiwei, Great Yuan raiders reached Bian city.
translations.idiomatic: On yiwei Great Yuan raiders reached Bian.

sentences.zh: 丁酉，大雪。

translations.literal: On dingyou, heavy snow fell.
translations.idiomatic: On dingyou there was heavy snow.

sentences.zh: 大元兵及兩省軍戰鈞州之三峰山，兩省軍大潰，合達、陳和尚、楊沃衍走鈞州，城破皆死之。

translations.literal: Great Yuan troops and the two-province army fought at Three Peak Mountain in Junzhou; the two-province army was utterly routed. Heda, Chen Heshang, and Yang Woyan fled to Junzhou; when the city fell they all died.
translations.idiomatic: Great Yuan and the two-province armies fought at Three Peak Mountain in Junzhou; the Jin force was routed. Heda, Chen Heshang, and Yang Woyan fled into Junzhou and perished when it fell.

sentences.zh: 樞密副使蒲阿就執，尋亦死。

translations.literal: Privy Council Vice Director Pu'a was captured and soon died as well.
translations.idiomatic: Privy Council vice director Pu'a was taken prisoner and soon died.

sentences.zh: 武仙走密縣。

translations.literal: Wu Xian fled to Mi County.
translations.idiomatic: Wu Xian fled to Mi County.

sentences.zh: 自是，兵不復振，己亥，徐州行省完顏慶山奴引兵入援，義勝軍校侯進、杜正、張興率所部北降，慶山奴入睢州。

translations.literal: From then the army never recovered its spirit. On jihai, Xuzhou traveling secretariat Wanyan Qingshan Nu led troops in relief; Victory Army officers Hou Jin, Du Zheng, and Zhang Xing led their units north to surrender; Qingshan Nu entered Suizhou.
translations.idiomatic: After that the army never rallied. On jihai Xuzhou commissioner Wanyan Qingshan Nu marched to relieve the capital; Victory Army officers Hou Jin, Du Zheng, and Zhang Xing took their men north and surrendered; Qingshan Nu withdrew into Suizhou.

sentences.zh: 庚子，禦端門肆赦，改元開興。

translations.literal: On gengzi the emperor held a grand amnesty at the Du Gate and changed the era name to Kaixing.
translations.idiomatic: On gengzi the emperor proclaimed a general amnesty at the Du Gate and adopted the era name Kaixing.

sentences.zh: 辛丑，潼關守將李平以關降大元。

translations.literal: On xinchou, Tong Pass defender Li Ping surrendered the pass to Great Yuan.
translations.idiomatic: On xinchou Tong Pass defender Li Ping surrendered the pass to Great Yuan.

sentences.zh: 壬寅，扶溝民錢大亨、李鈞叛，殺縣令王浩及其簿尉。

translations.literal: On renyin, Fugou commoners Qian Daheng and Li Jun rebelled and killed Magistrate Wang Hao and his registrar and bailiff.
translations.idiomatic: On renyin Fugou commoners Qian Daheng and Li Jun revolted and killed Magistrate Wang Hao and his registrar and bailiff.

sentences.zh: 庚戌，許州軍變，殺元帥古裏甲石倫、粘合仝周、蘇椿等，以城降大元。

translations.literal: On gengxu, Xuzhou troops mutinied, killed Marshals Gulijia Shilun, Nihe Quanzhou, Su Chun, and others, and surrendered the city to Great Yuan.
translations.idiomatic: On gengxu Xuzhou troops mutinied, killed marshals Gulijia Shilun, Nihe Quanzhou, Su Chun, and others, and surrendered the city to Great Yuan.

sentences.zh: 二月壬子朔，慶山奴謀走歸德，至陽驛店遇大元兵，徐帥完顏兀裏力戰而死，慶山奴被擒，使招京城，不從。

translations.literal: Second month, on the renzi new moon: Qingshan Nu plotted to flee to Guide; at Yangyi post station he met Great Yuan troops; Xuzhou commander Wanyan Wuli fought to the death; Qingshan Nu was captured and ordered to summon the capital but refused.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month, on the renzi new moon, Qingshan Nu planned to flee to Guide; at Yangyi post he met Great Yuan troops; Xuzhou commander Wanyan Wuli fought to the death; Qingshan Nu was captured and told to summon the capital but refused.

sentences.zh: 睢州刺史張文壽棄城從慶山奴，皆死之。

translations.literal: Suizhou Prefect Zhang Wenshou abandoned the city to follow Qingshan Nu; all died.
translations.idiomatic: Suizhou Prefect Zhang Wenshou deserted the city to follow Qingshan Nu; all were killed.

sentences.zh: 甲寅，大元兵徇臨渙，攝縣令張若愚死之。

translations.literal: On jiayin, Great Yuan troops swept Linhuai; Acting Magistrate Zhang Ruoyu died.
translations.idiomatic: On jiayin Great Yuan forces overran Linhuai; acting magistrate Zhang Ruoyu was killed.

sentences.zh: 戊午，次盧氏。

translations.literal: On wuwu, they halted at Lushi.
translations.idiomatic: On wuwu they halted at Lushi.

sentences.zh: 關、陝行省總帥兩軍及秦、藍帥府軍棄潼關而東，與之遇，天又大雪，未戰而潰。

translations.literal: The Guan-Shaan traveling secretariat's two armies and the Qin-Lan command headquarters armies abandoned Tong Pass and marched east; they met the enemy; snow fell heavily again; without fighting they routed.
translations.idiomatic: Guan-Shaan traveling secretariat forces and Qin-Lan headquarters troops abandoned Tong Pass and marched east; they met the enemy; heavy snow fell again; they routed without a battle.
