sentences.zh: 行省徒單兀典、總帥納合合閏敗死，完顏重喜降，斬于馬前。

translations.literal: Traveling Secretariat Tushan Wudian and Commander-in-Chief Nahan Hehun were defeated and died; Wanyan Zhongxi surrendered and was beheaded before the horses.
translations.idiomatic: Traveling secretariat Tushan Wudian and commander-in-chief Nahan Hehun were beaten and killed; Wanyan Zhongxi surrendered and was beheaded before the army.

sentences.zh: 都尉鄭倜殺都尉苗英亦降。

translations.literal: Commandant Zheng Ti killed Commandant Miao Ying and also surrendered.
translations.idiomatic: Commandant Zheng Ti killed commandant Miao Ying and surrendered as well.

sentences.zh: 秦、藍總帥府經歷商衡死之。

translations.literal: Qin-Lan command headquarters staff officer Shang Heng died.
translations.idiomatic: Qin-Lan headquarters staff officer Shang Heng was killed.

sentences.zh: 大元兵下睢州。

translations.literal: Great Yuan troops took Suizhou.
translations.idiomatic: Great Yuan forces captured Suizhou.

sentences.zh: 庚申，翰林待制馮延登北來歸。

translations.literal: On gengshen, Hanlin Academician Awaiting Appointment Feng Yandeng came north to return.
translations.idiomatic: On gengshen Hanlin academician awaiting appointment Feng Yandeng returned from the north.

sentences.zh: 乙丑，大元兵攻歸德。

translations.literal: On yichou, Great Yuan troops attacked Guide.
translations.idiomatic: On yichou Great Yuan forces attacked Guide.

sentences.zh: 庚午，起複右丞相致仕賽不為左丞相。

translations.literal: On gengwu, retired Right Grand Councillor Saibu was recalled as Left Grand Councillor.
translations.idiomatic: On gengwu retired right grand councillor Saibu was recalled as left grand councillor.

sentences.zh: 括京師民軍二十萬分隸諸帥，人月給粟一石有五鬥。

translations.literal: The capital's militia of two hundred thousand were registered under various commanders; each man received one shi and five dou of grain per month.
translations.idiomatic: Two hundred thousand capital militia were assigned to commanders; each man was rationed one shi and five dou of grain monthly.

sentences.zh: 三月丁亥，大元軍平中京，留守撒合輦投水死。

translations.literal: Third month, on dinghai, Great Yuan forces pacified Middle Capital; Garrison-Chief Sahelian threw himself into the water and died.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month, on dinghai, Great Yuan forces took Middle Capital; garrison chief Sahelian drowned himself.

sentences.zh: 甲午，命平章政事白撒宿上清宮，樞密副使合喜宿大佛寺，以備緩急。

translations.literal: On jiawu, an edict ordered Grand Councillor Bai Sa to lodge at the Upper Clarity Palace and Privy Council Vice Director Hexi to lodge at the Great Buddha Temple against emergencies.
translations.idiomatic: On jiawu an edict billeted Grand Councillor Bai Sa at the Upper Clarity Palace and Privy Council vice director Hexi at the Great Buddha Temple for emergencies.

sentences.zh: 大元遣使自鄭州來諭降，使者立出國書以授譯史，譯史以授宰相，宰相跪進，上起立受之，以付有司。

translations.literal: Great Yuan sent envoys from Zhengzhou to urge surrender; the envoy stood forth with the state letter and handed it to the translator; the translator gave it to the chancellor; the chancellor knelt and advanced it; the emperor rose to receive it and handed it to the proper offices.
translations.idiomatic: Great Yuan envoys came from Zhengzhou to demand surrender; the envoy presented the state letter to the translator, who passed it to the chancellor; the chancellor knelt and offered it; the emperor stood to receive it and sent it to the proper offices.

sentences.zh: 書索翰林學士趙秉文、衍聖公孔元措等二十七家，及歸順人家屬，蒲阿妻子，繡女、弓匠、鷹人又數十人。

translations.literal: The letter demanded Academician Zhao Bingwen, Confucius-descendant Kong Yuancuo, and twenty-seven other households, plus families of those who had submitted, Pu'a's wife and children, and further dozens of embroiderers, bow-makers, and falconers.
translations.idiomatic: The letter listed Academician Zhao Bingwen, Confucius heir Kong Yuancuo, and twenty-seven other households, families of submitters, Pu'a's wife and children, and dozens more of embroiderers, bow-makers, and falconers.

sentences.zh: 庚子，封荊王子訛可為曹王，議以為質。

translations.literal: On gengzi the Prince of Jing's son Eke was enfeoffed as Prince of Cao, discussed as a hostage.
translations.idiomatic: On gengzi the Prince of Jing's son Eke was made Prince of Cao, intended as a hostage.

sentences.zh: 密國公璹以曹王幼，請代行，上慰遣之，不聽其代。

translations.literal: Duke of Mi Su urged that the Prince of Cao was young and asked to go in his stead; the emperor comforted him but would not allow substitution.
translations.idiomatic: Duke of Mi Su said the Prince of Cao was young and offered to go instead; the emperor consoled him but would not accept the exchange.

sentences.zh: 壬寅，尚書左丞李蹊送曹王出質，諫議大夫裴滿阿虎帶、太府監國世榮為請和使。

translations.literal: On renyin, Left Vice Director Li Xi escorted the Prince of Cao out as hostage; Remonstrance Officer Peiman Ahu Dai and Grand Storehouse Superintendent Guo Shirong were peace envoys.
translations.idiomatic: On renyin left vice director Li Xi escorted the Prince of Cao out as hostage; remonstrance officer Peiman Ahu Dai and grand storehouse superintendent Guo Shirong were peace envoys.

sentences.zh: 戶部侍郎楊慥權參知政事。

translations.literal: Revenue Vice Director Yang Zao was acting Participation Councillor.
translations.idiomatic: Revenue vice director Yang Zao was acting participation councillor.

sentences.zh: 分軍防守四城。

translations.literal: Troops were divided to defend the four cities.
translations.idiomatic: Forces were split to garrison the four cities.

sentences.zh: 大元兵攻汴城，上出承天門撫西面將士。

translations.literal: Great Yuan troops attacked Bian city; the emperor went out the Gate of Heavenly Succession to encourage the western defenders.
translations.idiomatic: Great Yuan forces assaulted Bian; the emperor went out the Gate of Heavenly Succession to hearten the western defenders.

sentences.zh: 千戶劉壽語不遜，詔釋勿問。

translations.literal: Thousand-Commander Liu Shou spoke disrespectfully; an edict pardoned him without inquiry.
translations.idiomatic: Thousand-commander Liu Shou spoke insolently; an edict pardoned him without investigation.

sentences.zh: 癸卯，上複出撫東面將士，親傅戰傷者藥于南薰門下，仍賜卮酒。

translations.literal: On guimao the emperor again went out to encourage the eastern defenders and personally applied medicine to wounded soldiers below the Southern Fragrance Gate, also bestowing cups of wine.
translations.idiomatic: On guimao the emperor again encouraged the eastern defenders and personally dressed wounds below the Southern Fragrance Gate, also giving cups of wine.

sentences.zh: 出內府金帛器皿以賞戰士。

translations.literal: Gold, silks, and vessels from the inner treasury were issued to reward the fighters.
translations.idiomatic: Gold, silks, and vessels from the inner treasury were given to reward the troops.

sentences.zh: 乙巳，鳳翔府砲軍萬戶王阿驢、樊喬來歸。

translations.literal: On yisi, Fengxiang catapult-army wanhu Wang Alu and Fan Qiao came over to the government.
translations.idiomatic: On yisi Fengxiang catapult-army wanhu Wang Alu and Fan Qiao defected to the court.

sentences.zh: 己酉，造革車三千兩，已而不用。

translations.literal: On jiyou, three thousand leather wagons were made, then not used.
translations.idiomatic: On jiyou three thousand leather wagons were built, then abandoned.

sentences.zh: 置局養無家俘民。

translations.literal: An office was set up to support homeless captive commoners.
translations.idiomatic: An office was established to support homeless captives.

sentences.zh: 夏四月癸丑，兵士李新有功，擢四方館使。

translations.literal: Summer, fourth month, on guichou: soldier Li Xin had merit and was promoted to Four-Directions Envoy.
translations.idiomatic: In summer, the fourth month, on guichou, soldier Li Xin was promoted to Four-Directions envoy for merit.

sentences.zh: 元帥劉益叱其子戰死。

translations.literal: Marshal Liu Yi cursed his son, who died fighting.
translations.idiomatic: Marshal Liu Yi drove his son into battle, and the son was killed.

sentences.zh: 丁巳，遣戶部侍郎楊居仁奉金帛詣大元兵乞和。

translations.literal: On dingsi, Revenue Vice Director Yang Juren was sent with gold and silks to the Great Yuan camp to beg peace.
translations.idiomatic: On dingsi revenue vice director Yang Juren was sent with gold and silks to the Great Yuan camp to sue for peace.

sentences.zh: 戊午，又以珍異往謝許和。

translations.literal: On wuwu, rare treasures were again sent to thank them for granting peace.
translations.idiomatic: On wuwu rare gifts were sent again to thank them for agreeing to peace.

sentences.zh: 癸亥，明惠皇后陵被發，失柩所在，遣中官往視之，至是始得。

translations.literal: On guihai, the Minghui Empress's tomb was opened and the coffin's location was lost; palace eunuchs were sent to inspect; only now was it found.
translations.idiomatic: On guihai the Minghui Empress's tomb was violated and the coffin could not be found; palace eunuchs were sent to look; only then was it located.

sentences.zh: 以兵護宮女十人出迎朔門奉柩至城下，設禦幄安置，是夜複葬之。

translations.literal: Soldiers escorted ten palace women out the Welcome-Dawn Gate to meet the coffin at the wall; an imperial tent was set to receive it; that night it was reburied.
translations.idiomatic: Soldiers escorted ten palace women out the Welcome-Dawn Gate to meet the coffin at the wall; an imperial shelter was set up; that night it was reburied.

sentences.zh: 戮鄭倜妻子。

translations.literal: Zheng Ti's wife and children were executed.
translations.idiomatic: Zheng Ti's wife and children were put to death.

sentences.zh: 甲子，禦端門肆赦，改元天興。

translations.literal: On jiazi the emperor held a grand amnesty at the Du Gate and changed the era name to Tianxing.
translations.idiomatic: On jiazi the emperor proclaimed a general amnesty at the Du Gate and adopted the era name Tianxing.

sentences.zh: 詔內外官民能完複州郡者功賞有差。

translations.literal: An edict said that officials and commoners inside and outside the capital who could fully recover prefectures and districts would receive graded merit rewards.
translations.idiomatic: An edict promised graded rewards to officials and people who could fully restore lost prefectures and districts.

sentences.zh: 出金帛酒炙犒飫軍士。

translations.literal: Gold, silks, wine, and roasted meat were issued to feast and reward the troops.
translations.idiomatic: Gold, silks, wine, and roast meat were handed out to feast the army.

sentences.zh: 減禦膳，罷冗員，放宮女。

translations.literal: The imperial table was reduced, redundant staff dismissed, and palace women released.
translations.idiomatic: Court meals were cut, redundant posts abolished, and palace women released.

sentences.zh: 上書不得稱聖，改聖旨為制旨。

translations.literal: Memorials might no longer call him sage; "sage edicts" were changed to "regulatory edicts."
translations.idiomatic: Memorials could no longer call him sage, and "sage edicts" became "regulatory edicts."

sentences.zh: 釋鎬厲王、衛紹王二族禁錮，聽自便。

translations.literal: The confined clans of the Prince of Hao Li and the Prince of Wei Shaowang were released and allowed to go as they pleased.
translations.idiomatic: The imprisoned families of the Prince of Hao Li and the Prince of Wei Shaowang were freed to go where they wished.

sentences.zh: 乙丑，百官初起居於隆德殿前。

translations.literal: On yichou officials held their first regular audience before Longde Hall.
translations.idiomatic: On yichou the bureaucracy held its first regular audience before Longde Hall.

sentences.zh: 丙寅，以尚書省兼樞密院事。

translations.literal: On bingyin the Department of State was combined with Privy Council affairs.
translations.idiomatic: On bingyin the Department of State was merged with Privy Council business.

sentences.zh: 丁卯，放宮女，聽以衣裝自隨，金珠留犒士卒。

translations.literal: On dingmao palace women were released, permitted to take their clothing with them, and gold and pearls were kept to reward the troops.
translations.idiomatic: On dingmao palace women were released with their clothes, while gold and pearls were kept to reward the troops.

sentences.zh: 汴京解嚴，步軍始出封丘門采薪蔬。

translations.literal: The alert at Bianjing was lifted, and foot troops first went out Fengqiu Gate to gather fuel and vegetables.
translations.idiomatic: Bianjing stood down from alert, and infantry first left Fengqiu Gate to gather firewood and greens.

sentences.zh: 己巳，建威都尉完顏兀論同大元使沒忒入城。

translations.literal: On jisi Establishing Might Commandant Wanyan Ulun entered the city with Great Yuan envoy Motie.
translations.idiomatic: On jisi Establishing Might Commandant Wanyan Ulun brought Great Yuan envoy Motie into the city.

sentences.zh: 庚午，見使臣於隆德殿。

translations.literal: On gengwu he received the envoys at Longde Hall.
translations.idiomatic: On gengwu he received the envoys at Longde Hall.

sentences.zh: 放宮女如前。

translations.literal: Palace women were released as before.
translations.idiomatic: Palace women were released as before.

sentences.zh: 辛未，開鄭門聽百姓男子出入。

translations.literal: On xinwei Zheng Gate was opened so common men could enter and leave.
translations.idiomatic: On xinwei Zheng Gate was opened for civilian men to pass in and out.

sentences.zh: 甲戌，禦承天門大饗將士，聞有聲屈者乃還宮。

translations.literal: On jiaxu he went to Chengtian Gate to feast the troops greatly; hearing sounds of lamentation he returned to the palace.
translations.idiomatic: On jiaxu he went to Chengtian Gate to feast the army, but hearing wailing he turned back to the palace.

sentences.zh: 乙亥，有詔止奏事。

translations.literal: On yihai an edict stopped presenting business.
translations.idiomatic: On yihai an edict halted routine memorials.

sentences.zh: 許州進櫻桃。

translations.literal: Xu Prefecture presented cherries.
translations.idiomatic: Xu Prefecture sent cherries as tribute.

sentences.zh: 五月辛巳，遷民告出城者以萬數，賽不、白撒不聽。

translations.literal: Fifth month, xinsi: displaced people petitioning to leave the city numbered in the tens of thousands; Saibu and Baisha Bu would not hear them.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month, on xinsi, tens of thousands of displaced people asked to leave the city; Saibu and Baisha Bu refused.

sentences.zh: 乙酉，以南陽郡王子思烈行尚書省于鄧州，召援兵。

translations.literal: On yiyou the Prince of Nanyang's son Zisi was sent to exercise the Department of State at Deng Prefecture and summon reinforcements.
translations.idiomatic: On yiyou the Prince of Nanyang's son Zisi was sent to run the Department at Deng Prefecture and call up reinforcements.

sentences.zh: 丙戌，拜天於大慶殿，詔白撒致仕。

translations.literal: On bingxu he worshipped Heaven at Daqing Hall; an edict had Baisha Bu retire.
translations.idiomatic: On bingxu he worshipped Heaven at Daqing Hall and ordered Baisha Bu to retire.

sentences.zh: 放京城四面軍，李辛不奉詔。

translations.literal: The armies on all four sides of the capital were discharged; Li Xin did not obey the edict.
translations.idiomatic: The armies ringing the capital were discharged, but Li Xin would not obey.

sentences.zh: 丁亥，鑿洧川漕渠，尋罷之。

translations.literal: On dinghai the Wei River transport canal was dug, then the work was stopped.
translations.idiomatic: On dinghai the Wei River transport canal was opened, then the project was abandoned.

sentences.zh: 馮延登以奉使有勞，授禮部侍郎。

translations.literal: Feng Yandeng was made Vice Director of Rites for meritorious service on embassy.
translations.idiomatic: Feng Yandeng was made vice director of rites for distinguished embassy service.

sentences.zh: 戊子，裕州鎮防軍將領賀都喜率西軍二千人入援，放遷民出京。

translations.literal: On wuzi Yuzhou frontier defense leader He Duxi led two thousand Western Route troops to reinforce, and displaced people were allowed to leave the capital.
translations.idiomatic: On wuzi Yuzhou frontier defense leader He Duxi brought two thousand Western Route troops to reinforce, and displaced people were allowed out of the capital.

sentences.zh: 辛卯，大寒如冬。

translations.literal: On xinmao the cold was extreme, like winter.
translations.idiomatic: On xinmao bitter cold set in, as though it were winter.

sentences.zh: 密國公璹薨。

translations.literal: Duke of Michi Jun Jun died.
translations.idiomatic: Duke of Michi Jun Jun died.

sentences.zh: 汴京大疫，凡五十日，諸門出死者九十余萬人，貧不能葬者不在是數。

translations.literal: A great plague struck Bianjing; for fifty days more than nine hundred thousand dead were carried out the gates — the poor who could not bury them were not counted.
translations.idiomatic: A great plague ravaged Bianjing; for fifty days over nine hundred thousand corpses passed the gates, not counting the poor who could not afford burial.

sentences.zh: 癸巳，楊春入據亳州，觀察判官劉均死之。

translations.literal: On guisi Yang Chun entered and seized Bozhou; observation judge Liu Jun died defending it.
translations.idiomatic: On guisi Yang Chun seized Bozhou; observation judge Liu Jun died in the fighting.

sentences.zh: 辛丑，上禦香合，面責宰相。

translations.literal: On xinchou the emperor went to the Incense Pavilion and rebuked the chief ministers to their faces.
translations.idiomatic: On xinchou the emperor went to the Incense Pavilion and rebuked the chief ministers face to face.

sentences.zh: 乙巳，將相受保城爵賞。

translations.literal: On yisi generals and ministers received defend-city titles and rewards.
translations.idiomatic: On yisi generals and ministers received defend-city titles and rewards.

sentences.zh: 六月庚戌朔，詔百官舉大將，眾舉劉益，不能用。

translations.literal: Sixth month, gengxu new moon: an edict told all officials to recommend a great general; the masses recommended Liu Yi, but he was not appointed.
translations.idiomatic: On the sixth month's gengxu new moon an edict called for a great general; the crowd named Liu Yi, but he was not used.

sentences.zh: 癸丑，飛虎軍二百人奪封丘門出奔。

translations.literal: On guichou two hundred Flying Tiger troops seized Fengqiu Gate and fled.
translations.idiomatic: On guichou two hundred Flying Tiger soldiers stormed Fengqiu Gate and deserted.

sentences.zh: 甲寅，以出師錮門禁。

translations.literal: On jiayin, because troops were going out, the gates were barred.
translations.idiomatic: On jiayin, with troops marching out, the gates were shut tight.

sentences.zh: 乙卯，白撒開渠於私第東。

translations.literal: On yimao Baisha Bu opened a canal east of his private residence.
translations.idiomatic: On yimao Baisha Bu dug a canal east of his mansion.

sentences.zh: 丙辰，閱官馬，擇瘠者殺以食。

translations.literal: On bingchen official horses were reviewed; the emaciated were chosen and killed for food.
translations.idiomatic: On bingchen government horses were inspected and the thin ones slaughtered for meat.

sentences.zh: 丁巳，封仙據徐州，徒單益都走宿州，推張興行省事。

translations.literal: On dingsi Feng Xian seized Xuzhou; Toudan Yidu fled to Suzhou and made Zhang Xing acting Traveling Secretariat.
translations.idiomatic: On dingsi Feng Xian took Xuzhou; Toudan Yidu fled to Suzhou and set Zhang Xing over the traveling secretariat.

sentences.zh: 庚申，塞京城四門，以便守禦。

translations.literal: On gengshen the four gates of the capital were blocked to ease defense.
translations.idiomatic: On gengshen the capital's four gates were sealed for easier defense.

sentences.zh: 壬戌，國安用入徐州，殺張興，推封仙為元帥，以主州事。

translations.literal: On renxu Guo Anyong entered Xuzhou, killed Zhang Xing, and made Feng Xian marshal to handle prefectural affairs.
translations.idiomatic: On renxu Guo Anyong entered Xuzhou, killed Zhang Xing, and made Feng Xian marshal in charge of the prefecture.

sentences.zh: 己巳，詔贈禦侮中郎將完顏陳和尚鎮南軍節度使。

translations.literal: On jisi an edict posthumously made Defend-the-Foe Grand General Wanyan Chenheshang Military Commissioner of the Zhennan Army.
translations.idiomatic: On jisi an edict posthumously made Defend-the-Foe Grand General Wanyan Chenheshang military commissioner of the Zhennan Army.

sentences.zh: 立褒忠廟碑。

translations.literal: A Reward-Loyalty Temple stele was erected.
translations.idiomatic: A stele was raised at the Reward-Loyalty Temple.

sentences.zh: 權參知政事楊糸廷罷。

translations.literal: Acting Vice Grand Councillor Yang Sitai was dismissed.
translations.idiomatic: Acting vice grand councillor Yang Sitai was removed.

sentences.zh: 辛未，複修汴城。

translations.literal: On xinwei the walls of Bian were repaired again.
translations.idiomatic: On xinwei the Bian city walls were repaired again.

sentences.zh: 以疫後，園戶、僧道、醫師、鬻棺者擅厚利，命有司倍征之，以助其用。

translations.literal: After the plague, gardeners, monks and priests, physicians, and coffin sellers had taken excessive profit; offices were ordered to double-tax them to help expenses.
translations.idiomatic: After the plague gardeners, clergy, physicians, and coffin sellers had profiteered; offices were told to double their taxes to cover costs.

sentences.zh: 甲戌，宿州鎮防千戶高臘哥、李宣殺節度使紇石烈阿虎父子，請行省徒單益都主帥事，益都不從，率其將吏西走，至穀熟遇大元軍，死之。

translations.literal: On jiaxu Suzhou frontier defense chiliarchs Gao Lage and Li Xuan killed Military Commissioner Hesheli Ahu and his son, asked Toudan Yidu of the Traveling Secretariat to take command, Yidu refused, led his officers west, met Great Yuan troops at Gu Shu, and died.
translations.idiomatic: On jiaxu Suzhou frontier chiliarchs Gao Lage and Li Xuan killed military commissioner Hesheli Ahu and his son and asked traveling secretariat chief Toudan Yidu to command; Yidu refused, marched west with his staff, met Great Yuan forces at Gu Shu, and was killed.

sentences.zh: 乙亥，左丞李蹊送曹王與其子仝俱還。

translations.literal: On yihai Left Vice Director Li Xi sent Prince Cao and his son Tong back together.
translations.idiomatic: On yihai Left Vice Director Li Xi escorted Prince Cao and his son Tong home together.

sentences.zh: 丁丑，恆山公武仙殺士人李汾。

translations.literal: On dingchou Hengshan Duke Wu Xian killed the scholar Li Fen.
translations.idiomatic: On dingchou Duke of Hengshan Wu Xian killed the scholar Li Fen.

sentences.zh: 七月庚辰朔，兵刃有火。

translations.literal: Seventh month, gengchen new moon: weapons bore fire.
translations.idiomatic: On the seventh month's gengchen new moon weapons caught fire.

sentences.zh: 辛巳，軍士撾登聞鼓乞將劉益。

translations.literal: On xinsi soldiers beat the Petition-to-the-Throne drum asking for General Liu Yi.
translations.idiomatic: On xinsi soldiers beat the Petition drum demanding General Liu Yi.

sentences.zh: 癸未，尚書右丞顏盞世魯罷。

translations.literal: On guawei Right Vice Director of State Yanshan Shilu was dismissed.
translations.idiomatic: On guawei Right Vice Director of State Yanshan Shilu was dismissed.

sentences.zh: 吏部尚書完顏奴申為參知政事。

translations.literal: Minister of Personnel Wanyan Nushen was made Vice Grand Councillor.
translations.idiomatic: Minister of Personnel Wanyan Nushen was made vice grand councillor.

sentences.zh: 甲申，飛虎軍士申福、蔡元擅殺北使唐慶等三十余人於館，詔貰其罪，和議遂絕。

translations.literal: On jiashen Flying Tiger soldiers Shen Fu and Cai Yuan on their own killed northern envoy Tang Qing and more than thirty others at the hostel; an edict pardoned their crime, and peace talks then broke off.
translations.idiomatic: On jiashen Flying Tiger soldiers Shen Fu and Cai Yuan murdered northern envoy Tang Qing and more than thirty others at the lodge; an edict excused them, and peace negotiations collapsed.

sentences.zh: 乙酉，都人揚言欲殺白撒，密詔遣衛士護其家。

translations.literal: On yiyou the capital populace openly said they wished to kill Baisa; a secret edict sent guards to protect his house.
translations.idiomatic: On yiyou the people of the capital openly vowed to kill Baisa; a secret edict sent guards to protect his home.

sentences.zh: 丙戌，軍士毀白撒別墅。

translations.literal: On bingxu soldiers destroyed Baisa's suburban villa.
translations.idiomatic: On bingxu soldiers tore down Baisa's suburban villa.

sentences.zh: 斜撚阿不妄殺市人之過其門者以靖亂。

translations.literal: Xienian Abu wantonly killed market people who passed his gate, to calm the disorder.
translations.idiomatic: Xienian Abu killed market folk who passed his gate without cause, to quell the unrest.

sentences.zh: 丁亥，拜天于承天門下，出內府及兩宮物賜軍士。

translations.literal: On dinghai they worshipped Heaven below Chengtian Gate and gave out inner-palace and dual-palace goods to reward the troops.
translations.idiomatic: On dinghai the court worshipped Heaven below Chengtian Gate and distributed inner-palace and dual-palace goods to the troops.

sentences.zh: 戊子，下令招軍。

translations.literal: On wuzi an order was issued to recruit soldiers.
translations.idiomatic: On wuzi an edict ordered recruitment of troops.

sentences.zh: 辛卯，簽民為兵。

translations.literal: On xinmao the people were conscripted as soldiers.
translations.idiomatic: On xinmao civilians were drafted as soldiers.

sentences.zh: 鞏昌民百二十人赴援。

translations.literal: A hundred and twenty civilians of Gongchang came to reinforce.
translations.idiomatic: A hundred and twenty Gongchang civilians marched in to reinforce.

sentences.zh: 乙未，宿州帥眾僧奴稱國安用降，遣近侍直長因世英等持詔封安用為兗王，行京東等路尚書省事，賜姓完顏，改名用安。

translations.literal: On wei Suzhou commander Zhong Sengnu, claiming Guo An'yong had surrendered, sent Attendant Direct Regular Yin Shiying and others with an edict enfeoffing An'yong as Prince of Yan, acting Minister of the Eastern Capital and other circuits, granted the surname Wanyan, and renamed Yong'an.
translations.idiomatic: On wei Suzhou commander Zhong Sengnu, claiming Guo An'yong had submitted, sent Attendant Direct Regular Yin Shiying and others with an edict making An'yong Prince of Yan and acting minister over the Eastern Capital and other circuits, granted the surname Wanyan, and renamed him Yong'an.

sentences.zh: 新軍有撾登聞鼓者，杖殺之。

translations.literal: New-army men who beat the Petition Drum were flogged to death.
translations.idiomatic: New-army men who struck the Petition Drum were beaten to death.

sentences.zh: 乙巳，金、木、火、太陰會於軫、翼。

translations.literal: On yisi Venus, Jupiter, Mars, and the moon conjoined at Jiao and Yi.
translations.idiomatic: On yisi Venus, Jupiter, Mars, and the moon met in Jiao and Yi.

sentences.zh: 丙午，參知政事完顏思烈、恆山公武仙、鞏昌總帥完顏忽斜虎率諸將兵自汝州入援，以合喜為樞密使，將兵一萬應之，命左丞李蹊勸諭出師，乃行。

translations.literal: On bingwu Participation Councillor Wanyan Silie, Duke of Hengshan Wu Xian, and Gongchang commander-in-chief Wanyan Huxiehu led the generals' troops in relief from Ruzhou; Hexi was made privy councilor with ten thousand men to meet them; Left Vice Director Li Xi was ordered to urge the army out, and then they marched.
translations.idiomatic: On bingwu participation councillor Wanyan Silie, Duke of Hengshan Wu Xian, and Gongchang commander-in-chief Wanyan Huxiehu led the generals from Ruzhou in relief; Hexi was made privy councilor with ten thousand men to support them; left vice director Li Xi was told to urge the army forward, and they set out.

sentences.zh: 八月己酉朔，合喜屯杏花營，又益兵五千人，始進屯中牟故城。

translations.literal: Eighth month, jiyou new moon: Hexi encamped at Apricot Blossom Camp; another five thousand men were added, and he first advanced to camp at the old city of Zhongmou.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month, on the jiyou new moon, Hexi encamped at Apricot Blossom Camp; five thousand more were added and he first advanced to the old city of Zhongmou.

sentences.zh: 庚戌，發丁壯五千人運糧，餉合喜軍。

translations.literal: On gengxu five thousand able-bodied men were sent to transport grain and supply Hexi's army.
translations.idiomatic: On gengxu five thousand able-bodied men were sent to haul grain for Hexi's army.

sentences.zh: 辛亥，完顏思烈遇大元兵于京水，遂潰，武仙退保留山，思烈走禦寨，中京元帥左監軍任守貞死之。

translations.literal: On xinhai Wanyan Silie met Great Yuan troops at the Jingshui and was routed; Wu Xian retreated to Baoshan, Silie fled to Yu Camp, and Central Capital marshal left overseer Ren Shouzhen was killed.
translations.idiomatic: On xinhai Wanyan Silie met Great Yuan forces on the Jingshui and broke; Wu Xian fell back to Baoshan, Silie fled to Yu Camp, and Central Capital marshal left overseer Ren Shouzhen was killed.

sentences.zh: 合喜棄輜重奔至鄭門，聚兵乃入。

translations.literal: Hexi abandoned his baggage train, fled to Zheng Gate, gathered his troops, and only then entered.
translations.idiomatic: Hexi abandoned his baggage, fled to Zheng Gate, rallied his men, and then entered the city.

sentences.zh: 甲寅，免合喜為庶人，籍其家以賜軍士。

translations.literal: On jiayin Hexi was demoted to commoner and his household property was registered and given to the troops.
translations.idiomatic: On jiayin Hexi was reduced to commoner rank and his property was seized for the troops.

sentences.zh: 降監軍長東為符寶郎。

translations.literal: Overseer Changdong was demoted to insignia keeper.
translations.idiomatic: Overseer Changdong was reduced to insignia keeper.

sentences.zh: 丁巳，釋奠孔子。

translations.literal: On dingsi libation was offered to Confucius.
translations.idiomatic: On dingsi libation was offered to Confucius.

sentences.zh: 戊午，括民間粟，己未，籍徒單兀典、完顏重喜、納合合閏家貲。

translations.literal: On wuwu civilian grain was seized; on jiwei the property of Tushan Yuandian, Wanyan Zhongxi, and Nahehe Min was registered.
translations.idiomatic: On wuwu grain was seized from the people; on jiwei the estates of Tushan Yuandian, Wanyan Zhongxi, and Nahehe Min were confiscated.

sentences.zh: 前儀封令魏璠上言，「鞏昌帥完顏仲德沉毅有遠謀，臣請奉命往召。

translations.literal: Former Yifeng magistrate Wei Fan memorialized: "Gongchang commander Wanyan Zhongde is steady and far-sighted in counsel; I ask to be sent to summon him.
translations.idiomatic: Former Yifeng magistrate Wei Fan memorialized, "Gongchang commander Wanyan Zhongde is resolute and far-seeing; I beg leave to go summon him.

sentences.zh: 」不報。

translations.literal: " There was no reply.
translations.idiomatic: " There was no reply.

sentences.zh: 戊辰，免府試。

translations.literal: On wuchen the prefectural examination was waived.
translations.idiomatic: On wuchen the prefectural examination was waived.

sentences.zh: 起複前大司農侯摯為平章政事，進封蕭國公，行京東路尚書省事。

translations.literal: Former Grand Minister of Agriculture Hou Zhi was recalled from mourning as chief councillor, advanced to Duke of Xiao, and made acting Minister of the Eastern Capital circuit.
translations.idiomatic: Former grand minister of agriculture Hou Zhi was recalled from mourning as chief councillor, enfeoffed as Duke of Xiao, and made acting minister of the Eastern Capital circuit.

sentences.zh: 己巳，摯帥兵行至封丘，將士將潰，摯止之，乃與眾還汴。

translations.literal: On jisi Hou led troops to Fengqiu; the officers and men were about to scatter, but Hou stopped them and returned with the host to Bian.
translations.idiomatic: On jisi Hou led troops to Fengqiu; the army was near mutiny, but Hou held them together and marched back to Bian with the host.

sentences.zh: 壬申，聽無軍家口戍京。

translations.literal: On renshen families without military registration were allowed to garrison the capital.
translations.idiomatic: On renshen households without military registration were permitted to garrison the capital.

sentences.zh: 甲戌，金木星交。

translations.literal: On jiaxu Venus and Jupiter crossed.
translations.idiomatic: On jiaxu Venus and Jupiter crossed.

sentences.zh: 乙亥，賣官，及許買進士第。

translations.literal: On yihai offices were sold, and purchase of jinshi rank was permitted.
translations.idiomatic: On yihai offices were sold and buying a jinshi degree was allowed.

sentences.zh: 丙子，詔罷括粟，複以進獻取之。

translations.literal: On bingzi an edict ended grain seizure and again took grain through tribute presentation.
translations.idiomatic: On bingzi an edict ended grain seizures and again drew grain through presented tribute.

sentences.zh: 丁丑，京城民楊興入貲，授延州刺史。

translations.literal: On dingchou the capital resident Yang Xing paid a fee and was made prefect of Yanzhou.
translations.idiomatic: On dingchou capital resident Yang Xing bought office and was made prefect of Yanzhou.

sentences.zh: 戊寅，劉仲溫入貲，授許州刺史。

translations.literal: On wuyin Liu Zhongwen paid a fee and was made prefect of Xuzhou.
translations.idiomatic: On wuyin Liu Zhongwen bought office and was made prefect of Xuzhou.
